topics.title: Evidence scope and dated scientific status
topics.current_account: The 749 distinct received JSON bodies bind 811 selected public paths. They contain claims, finite controls, historical reviews, source-reading scopes and administrative history; the number of records is not a number of independent results.
topics.qualification: Current means relative to the frozen October source sequence. Later records govern only the scopes they explicitly address. No present publication, acceptance, category or deletion decision is made.

topics.title: Calibrated route laws and exact arithmetic identification
topics.current_account: Prime-valuation and profile inverses identify anonymous route histograms under the declared exact product law. Interior and joint no-hit coordinates distinguish multiplicities and bundles missed by corners or marginal summaries. The forward-law kernel record composes the actual finite Bernoulli assignment law with the finite inverse.
topics.qualification: External independence, calibration, intervention semantics, complete effect catalogues, productive interpretation and finite-data recovery remain additional premises. Countable signature complexity is in expanded exact rational input; nonunit private-prime valuations and infinite tails retain their separate treatments.

topics.title: Unknown calibration, grouped mixtures, noise and adaptive bounds
topics.current_account: Held-label moments and interpolation recover finite catalogue weights under independent groups and separation conditions. Unknown common calibration creates scale ambiguities; primitive-pattern and bounded noisy recovery remove only their specified ambiguities. Transcript information bounds are tied to a fixed observation model.
topics.qualification: Freshly redrawn labels, dependent groups, component-specific calibrations, rare unseen labels, calibration bias, boundary rates and route-addressable gates invalidate broader readings. Synthetic histograms are not empirical observations. Confidence, fixed-budget and expected-stopping regimes remain distinct.

topics.title: Interaction support, gauges and absence information
topics.current_account: Finite incidence panels identify row-space targets; positive unary anchors, aggregate boundaries and cover promises support different conditional recovery procedures. Pointwise oracle access supports the qualified approximation and absence-obstruction results.
topics.qualification: Finite panels do not determine a whole calibration function. A zero-count sign search failing to halt is not a universal absence theorem. Complete absence decisions need their precise oracle, return and error hypotheses; a total ceiling is not an exact total or a separate gift for each support.

topics.title: Dependent gates, held thresholds and charged inquiry
topics.current_account: Fresh endpoint laws and retained-threshold pair laws have different identification power. The all-command rigidity and finite reference tests retain their stated assumptions. Adaptive two-face chi-square optimization and lower bounds charge every started attempt.
topics.qualification: A finite panel cannot certify global copula independence. Equality of adaptive chi-square suprema is not equality of KL suprema. Screening costs, abort labels, confidence and world-specific expected costs must remain explicit; numerical cancellation is not a zero-information theorem.

topics.title: Minima, interior certificates and skyline information
topics.current_account: Retained minima, finite interior panels and full skylines are distinct experiments. The later source sequence resolves the known-pair sharp vector rate as Theta(n^4/log^2 n), with reverse KL and Hellinger asymptotics and an eventual quantized geometric-score test.
topics.qualification: Forward skyline KL remains infinite on its singular stratum; minima chi-square is infinite despite finite KL. Local score expansions need their windows and tail arguments. No numerical cutoff, all-n guarantee, unknown-pair theorem, noisy-access theorem or total-query optimum is certified.

topics.title: Representation, identity and formal scope
topics.current_account: Finite qualitative tensor interpretation, copyable identity and coherent modal transport have precise positive representation results. Witness transport and common fixed points are separate from existence of individual loop fixed points. Graph-related formal status is limited to the named finite-support combinatorics and pointwise bridge.
topics.qualification: Signed cancellation, coefficient rings with idempotents, empty sorts, frozen evaluation covectors, lost receipt witnesses and changed state representations are retained controls. Representation and historical kernel success do not establish external ontology or unreceived theorem bodies.

topics.title: Explanation, modal actualisation and qualitative rivals
topics.current_account: Plural explanation, total-explainer uniqueness and modal actualisation operate at specified fact and totality domains. The qualitative rival has substantive abductive force while the restricted resource interface remains distinct from an unrestricted philosophical Completion claim.
topics.qualification: Fusion is not conjunction; facts are not productive bearers. Local explanatory adequacy does not imply total uniqueness. Stronger essential profiles, productive bridges and particular-fact scope need independent premises. Unreceived replies and partially read external works remain limitations.

topics.title: Original provision, nonduplication and field-relative unity
topics.current_account: The received history includes affirmative defeasible common-source and original-provision appraisals with explicit causal-nonduplication, source-mode and mediate-attribution premises. Their positive rationales and the continuing scope objections are retained together.
topics.qualification: Connectedness does not supply its local propagation premise. Entire original production differs from sufficient conditions and unused capacity. The strong brute rival may be productive. Capacity, standing mode, activity genus and token act remain distinct; finite polynomial controls do not certify perfected original plurality.

topics.title: Knowledge, wise determination and particular agency
topics.current_account: The source accounts distinguish knowing efficacy, particular intrinsic wise willing, centered semantics, role-sensitive policies and action-guiding basing. The intellectual-production rival receives its knowing and purposive interpretation.
topics.qualification: A generic capacity or successful goal does not supply the entire practical determination. A necessary reasons-state does not itself imply a necessary action history. The inherited policy did not use the centered forecast; stronger epistemic basing requires an additional interpretation.

topics.title: Operative basing, relevant implication and recognition
topics.current_account: The relevant-logic positive derivation and finite soundness controls distinguish internal relevant implication from ordinary theoremhood. Selective recognition and testimony arguments separate local tracking, competence, entitlement, provenance and knowledge.
topics.qualification: Necessary-target tracking is vacuous as a competence discriminator. Semantic function or content-sensitive control alone does not establish present inferential basing. Finite companion models are diagnostic; the unreceived chapter and unauthenticated historical episodes remain unavailable at the stated scope.

topics.title: Evidence frontiers, inquiry and compilation
topics.current_account: A finite support/cost frontier preserves future evidence distinctions under fixed commitments. The Bellman account reconstructs a witness with minimum worst-case execution cost; restricted tree compilation and whole-graph methods address different construction problems.
topics.qualification: Execution cost excludes compiling, planning and authenticating the rules. Intermediate pruning fails for shared graphs, as the retained 9-versus-5 witness shows. Unsupported is not false, and constructed witnesses do not establish external warrant or human basing.

topics.title: Normative reasons, owned veracity, authority and attestation
topics.current_account: Affirmative defeasible appraisals concern intrinsic reasons and exceptionless veracity within the scope of genuinely owned assertions. Properly authenticated owned testimony has a positive warrant route. Contextual attestation requires a discriminating intentional organization.
topics.qualification: Necessary existence alone is insufficient; the knowledgeable-liar critic survives. Causally enabling a creature does not own its assertion. Authority requires jurisdiction, directives and recipient-role premises, and a token cannot authenticate itself by asserting authority.

topics.title: Empirical arithmetic and source-access distinctions
topics.current_account: The seven-row arithmetic record retains exactly two inconsistent printed significance claims and the explicitly one-tailed preserved control. Source-return records distinguish complete displayed manuscripts, partial pages, print controls, OCR defects, inaccessible bodies and later corrected reading scopes.
topics.qualification: No participant-level replication, new source acquisition or current correspondence check occurred. Failure to find data is not proof of nonexistence. Edition differences, damaged passages, quotations, secondary claims and missing historical bytes must not be silently repaired or upgraded.

topics.title: Retained limitations and lossless historical evidence
topics.current_account: Every original source value, exact number lexeme, container, occurrence and selected alias survives in the normalized owner. Historical owner fields remain explicitly dated. Structured values are shared only after exact typed-content equality, without claims of argument equivalence.
topics.qualification: Consumer compatibility, independent review, public acceptance and any original-path disposition remain root-owned and unresolved by this author packet. Body examination, source counts and structural sharing earn no consolidation, category, removal or adoption credit by themselves.

current_findings.statement: The principal mathematical achievements concern what can be recovered from a specified observation interface, what changes when calibration or dependence is unknown, and what inquiry costs remain after the observation process is fixed. The philosophical work concerns whole-existence explanation, original productive provision, agency, knowledge, normative reasons and authority. A mathematical representation can clarify a premise or expose an invalid inference without establishing that the represented situation is physically or metaphysically possible. Conversely, an affirmative philosophical appraisal is not accurately represented by an earlier open status merely because its premises remain substantive and contested. Both points matter throughout this account. [S0319] [S0391] [S0241] [S0261]

“Kernel checked” below means that a received record reports a check of named, hash-bound formal files with its stated toolchain and axioms. “Written result” means that the record attributes the general argument to a specified mathematical manuscript or review. “Finite control” means a bounded exact enumeration, symbolic check, rational interval calculation or numerical diagnostic. This consolidation did not rerun those programs, inspect omitted proof bodies, collect observations or consult new primary sources. Where the received JSON supplies only a theorem statement, dependency or review record, the fuller proof remains a source-reported dependency rather than a newly reproduced proof. Separate internal reviews are not external human peer review. [S0448] [S0529] [S0208] [S0399] [S0468]

The basic finite model has a fixed inventory of productive routes, root supports and, in the guarded extension, fixed guards and output sets. At a declared calibration, a route succeeds with the stipulated product probability, and route successes are independent. The observable is the endpoint law or a family of no-hit probabilities. It identifies an anonymous histogram of route classes and outputs when the appropriate inverse is injective. It does not, by itself, identify a physical mechanism, a named productive bearer or a unique causal interpretation of an endpoint. Re-solving a policy after changing an input changes the intrinsic setting; it is not automatically the same intervention. Equal unattenuated supports can coexist with different joint attenuated laws. [S0023] [S0724]

Two elementary controls show why the whole observation contract matters. A single A-route, two independent A-routes and an A-route supplemented by an AB-route agree at deterministic root corners. At the interior point a=b=1/2 their success probabilities are respectively 1/2, 3/4 and 5/8. Algebraically, the differences from the single A-route are a(1−a) and ab(1−a). The corners therefore recover a Boolean response quotient, not all multiplicities or Boolean-redundant additions. Holding a random root gate fixed across routes can hide copies and absorbed routes that are visible under independent route gates. Source deletion, incidence gating, support-route gating and whole-route thinning must not be interchanged. [S0003] [S0023] [S0558]

For multiple effects, no-hit information preserves whether one route produces a bundle or separate routes produce its members. In the supplied bundled/separate example, individual no-hit coordinates agree, while a joint query gives 5/6 for the bundle and 25/36 for separate independent routes. Thus a claim based only on retained or marginal coordinates is narrower than a claim based on the full endpoint law. The omission-oracle controls retain precisely that distinction. [S0023] [S0724]

Under an exact rational product law, taking prime valuations converts products raised to integer multiplicities into a linear system. An injective valuation matrix determines the histogram. Conversely, a nonzero integer kernel vector can be split and lifted to nonnegative inventories, producing a genuine algebraic ambiguity under the chosen panel. The retained three-root examples have ranks five and six for two individually deficient calibrations, rank seven when they are stacked, and rank seven for a suitable single alternative. Their explicit integer kernels, lifted guarded inventories and separating repair probabilities survive in the index. A matrix-rank computation is evidence about that declared response law, not a test of the external independence or calibration premises. [S0023] [S0701]

The single-calibration construction assigns private prime signatures to supports through congruence choices. A private prime need not occur to valuation one. The supplied six-root examples give valuation two at support 1 with prime 41 and at support 16 with prime 107; decoding must divide by that known coefficient. This correction matters because a private diagonal signature alone does not justify reading its valuation directly as the multiplicity. The construction still needs all relevant profiles, correct guard handling and an exact readout. [S0362] [S0600] [S0609]

The formal inverse record reports a theorem for an arbitrary finite effect type and five natural-valued histograms vanishing at the empty output. Equality of the actual rational three-panel families on every nonempty query implies equality of the histograms. It names both the histogram and coefficientwise endpoints, Lean 4.19.0, the pinned mathlib revision and the standard axioms `propext`, `Classical.choice` and `Quot.sound`; it reports no added axioms or admitted proofs. The rejected mutations change the 5/6 failure factor, remove query intersection or leave the main injectivity goal unsolved. [S0448]

The later forward-law record closes a different formal gap: it sums product Bernoulli masses over Boolean route-success assignments, proves assignment and endpoint normalization, groups occurrences into histograms, derives the three panels and composes them with the frozen inverse. Occurrence types may differ between the compared inventories. That is stronger than assuming the observable product formula as an unexplained equation. It still leaves external calibration, independence, productive interpretation, a complete effect catalogue, exact population observation, incidence-gate equivalence and finite-sample inference outside the formal theorem. These are retained obligations, not defects repaired by the theorem's name. [S0529]

The countable-signature construction uses base-four factors and primitive-divisor ancestry to distinguish finite-support integer histograms from exact rational readouts. Low exponents have explicit primes 3 and 5. A descending decoder can remove composite prime support by greatest-common-divisor stripping rather than requiring factorization or multiplicative-order computation. Its polynomial claim is measured in the expanded binary numerator and denominator; it is not a complexity bound for compact expressions or for collecting empirical frequencies. The alternative-base exceptional blocks and the complete finite traces remain separately indexed. [S0374] [S0536] [S0542] [S0657]

The infinite-tail construction has a different purpose. Its written convergence argument reaches the exact target 3/4, while every retained finite prefix remains a prefix. The corrected digit estimate is f_e^5<f_(e−1). A second exact query can reject a supplied finite candidate under an expanded class; this is not a finite-precision decision procedure for whether the unknown inventory is finite. Finite panels can miss a guard, finite Cauchy prefixes can fit distinct nonempty inventories, and real convergence does not preserve prime valuations. Fixed mixtures can also collide even at a fixed calibration. A grouped second moment separates the supplied pair, but that example is not a general finite-mixture identification theorem. [S0374] [S0513]

Finally, distinct full-support sampling laws overlap on every finite data record. The exact population inverse cannot therefore be relabelled as a zero-error certificate from finitely many observations. The finite total-variation witnesses in the original controls survive with their trial counts and exact fractions. [S0023]

For a known finite catalogue with distinct response nodes z_i, repeated Bernoulli observations sharing one latent label yield moments of the mixing measure. Polynomial interpolation supplies label contrasts: a polynomial that equals one at z_i and zero at other nodes has expectation equal to the corresponding mixture weight. Expressing the contrast in a Bernstein/count basis gives a finite-sample range bound. The resulting concentration guarantee requires the stated independent group structure, repetitions within each group, positive-weight floor and calibration allowance. Ordered binary words and binomial counts are related experiments, but their probabilities and coefficients must not be confused. [S0151] [S0250]

The supplied three-label example discloses 40,000 independent groups, two endpoints per group, a positive-weight floor 1/3, code error 1/1000 and sufficient port error 1/2000. Its worst contrast range is 50/3, derivative allowance 100/3, calibration floor 1/30 and remaining margin 2/15. These are sufficient constants for that design, not a minimax comparison. The same control array shows a small calibration bias, a boundary with no selected support and a larger bias selecting the wrong support. Increasing the sample size does not remove a fixed misspecified calibration bias. [S0151]

Freshly resampling the latent label at every endpoint destroys the held-label moments. Dependence between groups can likewise leave a nonvanishing contrast variance: the retained obstruction has endpoint covariance 1/64 and asymptotic contrast variance 1/4. A statistical guarantee cannot be transported from independent groups merely because a one-endpoint mean is unchanged. Positive nodes in (0,1) exclude the zero-count atom at 1 unless the model explicitly includes it. [S0151] [S0250]

When one unknown calibration is shared by all labels, changing count scale and changing the calibration can preserve every finite-horizon grouped law. The equivalence is not confined to integer rescaling: the retained support sets {2,4} and {3,6} provide a direct noninteger example. Recovering a primitive count pattern requires the stated common-calibration and positivity assumptions. Label-specific calibrations counterfeit the ratios; a step calibration with no interior value defeats a method that requires one. Two repeated observations are insufficient for the supplied shifted primitive pair: its first two moments agree at 189/400 and 243/1024, while its third moments differ by 26973/6553600. [S0015] [S0379] [S0442]

Global calibration-error results compare explicit feasible scale sets, exact boundary contacts and positive gaps. Below a permitted ambiguity threshold, a suitable command can separate the remaining catalogue; at or above an exact contact, different worlds can share the observable law. The confidence domain 0<δ<1/2, a fixed unknown actual calibration and fresh conditionally Bernoulli trials remain part of the theorem. Abstention and nontermination are not silently counted as success. A chosen M^−2 scale is not a universal polynomial threshold, and the separate eventual fixed-confidence appendix is not an expected-stopping or variable-confidence theorem. [S0227] [S0597] [S0626]

Stable grouped recovery adds a bounded count catalogue, weight floor, separation and a finite grid. Nonnegative annihilating polynomials turn moment proximity into a support-separation certificate; grid rounding must leave enough weight and calibration margin. The complete supplied witness uses M=3, C=2, support {1,3}, weights 2/7 and 5/7, and true rate 7/10. Its very large exact synthetic histogram passes the declared radius. It is a constructed count-frequency witness: no observations were drawn and no exhaustive grid search was run. The rare zero-mass obstruction, unbounded-count approximation and component-specific-calibration counterfeits survive alongside the positive construction. [S0443] [S0627]

The noise-aware route inverse chooses nonsaturating masks under an independently supplied total-route bound K, propagates rational bounds through logarithms and Möbius transforms, and rounds only after the interval certifies a unique integer. Its arithmetic certificate certifies rounding for the supplied probability panel. Truth of the recovered inventory additionally needs the statistical good event and the model assumptions. An inadequate precision budget must lead to abstention rather than an unjustified count. The retained example combines bounded calibration leakage and endpoint perturbations and recovers its declared three-route histogram; it is synthetic, not empirical validation. A bound on marginal gate errors alone does not control gate correlation. [S0466] [S0460] [S0648]

with r≥2 and L≥r+1. The matching order Θ(L^(2r) log(1/δ)) is for fixed root dimension and catalogue, the declared fresh independent-route observations and fixed budget, with the reported confidence qualifications. It is not an expected-stopping or unbounded-dimension result. [S0543] [S0667] [S0570]

The negative controls identify exactly why a broader claim fails. Route-addressable gating can suppress the baseline and enable the added route, making one endpoint decisive. Shared random root gates give equal probabilities 1/4 and 1/4 in a case where independent routes give 1/16 and 3/64. An uncovered root invalidates the balanced bound; rates approaching the boundary have no uniform positive variance floor; and the binary divergence-to-log ratio vanishes as confidence approaches random guessing. These are preserved exclusions of the observation model, not inconvenient rows to remove. [S0521]

Interior log-response equations can identify interaction quantities while leaving a calibration gauge. The relevant linear object is an incidence matrix: null directions preserve the observed panel, and a target is identified exactly when it lies in the appropriate row space. A full-rank finite panel identifies its sampled parameters; it does not determine an entire unknown calibration function away from sampled commands. Nor may a log-rate row be normalized as though it were a probability-mass row. The triangle, AB/ABC and unsigned-graph controls distinguish complete and partial identification, including the bipartite/odd-cycle criterion in the relevant graph case. [S0625] [S0480]

A positive unary anchor permits an integer search using certified signs at half-integer cuts. The count is recovered when the intervals establish the required side of each cut. A zero count may stall that particular sign procedure. That fact alone is not a theorem that every form of absence information is unavailable. Separate anchored observations, boundary reductions or independently supplied ceilings have different contracts. The finite control costs—such as the largest observed precision or number of oracle calls—are observations about the controls, not uniform theorem bounds. [S0424] [S0303] [S0365]

At a unit calibration boundary, a reduced inventory can reveal aggregate counts and allow point reconstruction. With an all-command point oracle and the stipulated monotonicity and continuity, a finite polygonal approximation can be refined until it meets the required error. The stopping mesh depends on the function's certified local behavior; there is no prior uniform modulus, sample bound or runtime bound across every possible world. The representation addendum also preserves discontinuity/no-stop and nonmonotone-panel controls. [S0480] [S0642]

Four related tasks remain distinct. A supplied total ceiling can support complete support/count recovery. A residual total budget can constrain a joint unary-count fibre without choosing a unique tuple. A known positive-count cover can permit a conditional recovery without supplying a target count ceiling. Fair search can discover a complete interaction cover only under its structural promise. The symbol M is a total bound, not an exact total or a separate bound granted independently to each support. Without a cover promise, partial discovery or a timeout establishes no absence. [S0473] [S0160] [S0267] [S0650]

The absence obstruction is sharper than an observation that a particular search is slow. In the stated fixed finite two-root independent-route class, arbitrary valid pointwise Cauchy names can agree through every finite transcript relevant to a proposed uniformly reliable terminating decision. A nearby positive-interaction world can therefore defeat an asserted absence certificate. The randomized version retains the almost-sure return and uniform error-below-1/2 hypotheses. This is an obstruction for the declared oracle interface; it is not a claim about physical absence, bounded count classes or noisy experimental access in general. [S0550] [S0584] [S0660]

The preserved transcription correction belongs here: the correct review formula is Q_N=u(1−b)+bu^(1+1/N), equivalently u(1−b+b u^(1/N)). The shorter expression missing the extra u was a review transcription error; the author theorem and derivation already used the correct formula. It should neither remain a current formula nor be misreported as a newly repaired theorem. [S0420]

A valid joint gate law needs nonnegative rectangle masses and compatible marginals, not merely a monotone response surface. The dependent-gate construction uses a genuine Joe-family joint law to transport an independent n-route endpoint law to m≥n routes while retaining independence across routes and shared root marginals. Its mixture representation gives positive cells and rectangle masses. The converse excludes m<n even with heterogeneous within-route laws under the shared-margin and cross-route-independence assumptions. Allowing occurrence-specific marginals or dependence across routes defeats the corresponding product bound. The invalid c=2 surface is retained with exact negative rectangle masses −17/256 and −41/4096. [S0625] [S0102] [S0382]

The distinction between fresh and retained randomness is decisive. Repeating a command while redrawing thresholds is a new endpoint trial. Holding the same latent inventory but redrawing the gates does not provide the same data as retaining the actual thresholds. In the all-command rigidity result, the fresh endpoint function Q and a paired held-threshold function J together force the count, the calibration and the factorization of each joint gate law. The written argument uses the second-order coefficient to fix the count and pointwise inequalities to force equality in the factors. It does not require differentiability or an absolutely continuous copula. [S0045] [S0456] [S0699]

A finite panel cannot certify global copula independence. The supplied smooth perturbation has density bounded below by 1/2 and vanishes at every point of a chosen grid, yet differs off grid by −4725/1157730664448 at (1/8,3/8). The exact finite transcript remains unchanged. A separate high-panel three-bit alias at t=3/4 is an obstruction to that design, not a universal impossibility of finite count identification. Four exact low-rate probabilities can certify the finite count and local Bernoulli tables under their stated contract; route-specific calibration allows a separate m=2n alias. [S0456] [S0625]

The four-coordinate robust certificate has radius 1/[10000(n+1)^2] around the stated reference. It excludes every wrong positive integer count, not only a prespecified bounded list. A conservative sampling realization uses at least ceil(200000000(n+1)^4 log(8/α)) paired observations and the same number of diagonal observations: 2N replicates and 3N endpoint calls in that accounting. This is a test of a specified reference, not a general estimator for arbitrary unknown calibration and dependence. Its low-rate command has to be the true calibrated command. [S0573]

For a particular hard pair, the fixed-rate forward information bound is 3136/[625(n+1)^4]. A separate all-rate bound gives KL≤χ²≤32768/n^4. The asymptotic preselected two-face design has scaled chi-square supremum approximately 0.419399020222 and corresponding forward KL constant approximately 0.209699510111, attained asymptotically at u≈1.593624260040 satisfying u=2(1−e^−u). These constants answer different questions from the robust all-alternative reference test. They do not certify a finite-n optimizer, reverse-KL optimum, sharp testing constant or physical minimax statement. [S0573] [S0166] [S0358]

The numerical and interval failures are scientifically relevant. Naive floating-point and even fixed high-precision subtraction can cancel a positive information quantity to zero. One retained extreme control reports a stable positive chi-square near 8.72×10^−435 after a naive 80-digit expression became zero. A probability-generating-function enclosure check was strengthened from overlapping intervals to full containment after exact bisection. Boundary continuity and numerical grids do not establish an all-rate supremum. These limitations survive with the successful certificates. [S0358] [S0166]

For the specified two-face experiment, the complete transcript records the first command, its bit, the chosen second command or abort, and the second bit when taken. Conditioning on the first bit gives an exact chi-square decomposition. Optimizing the second rate on each branch yields the same supremum as the corresponding nonadaptive optimization in this contract. Randomized command kernels and aborts are included when their labels remain in the transcript; hiding them gives a data-processing inequality. This does not establish equality of adaptive KL suprema or an optimal KL constant. [S0508] [S0369]

Every first probe is charged. Screening until an unusual first response and charging only the eventual completed pair is a different cost model. In one retained case, one completed pair entails 15.625 expected first attempts and 16.625 expected endpoint probes. Selected conditional information increases, but its acquisition cost has increased as well. The lower-bound chain rule uses the correct world's expected charged attempts and unconditional terminal correctness, including the possibility of nontermination. Fresh redraws whose likelihoods agree contribute no separating information. [S0369] [S0677] [S0736]

Fix the stated known pair: n independent product-uniform routes versus m=n+1 Joe routes, with independent resets between retained vectors and noiseless threshold queries within a vector. Exact coordinatewise minima are one possible summary. Their two laws are mutually absolutely continuous. Their forward chi-square divergence is nevertheless infinite for every fixed n, while forward KL is finite and positive, with the recorded upper bound 2+log(1+1/[n(n+1)]). Finer dyadic minima can have chi-square growing linearly with resolution at fixed n. This is not a joint n-and-resolution sample theorem. [S0088]

The written minima KL asymptotic is 1/(2n^4). The argument first expresses both laws in one common coordinate system, expands their densities on a growing box and controls entropy in the tails separately. A global L² shortcut fails because of the infinite chi-square tail; applying different world-dependent transforms would not preserve the experiment being compared. Adaptive face-only histories are postprocessings of the retained minima under the common measurable policy and seed assumptions. The resulting lower bound concerns charged started vectors and unconditional terminal correctness. [S0088] [S0520]

Interior queries can reveal information the minima do not retain. An alternating staircase of m positive cells and m−1 negative connectors forces at least m total routes. With exactly m independent identically distributed routes, the certificate probability is m! times the product of the box masses; heterogeneous independent routes give the corresponding permanent. The Joe alternative has positive mass on an event impossible for the n-route baseline. At n=1, the supplied staircase probability is 10/3−8√14/9. The certificate-only waiting bound m^m/m! is not a lower bound for all tests. Without the pure AB route restriction the certificate forces only max(m−2,0) AB-routes, and dependence between routes can destroy the positive-probability argument. [S0088] [S0228]

For a finite two-dimensional panel, the minimum route count is zero if there are no positive cells, and otherwise one plus an interval-hitting number. The sharp 2m−1 query construction and the adaptive depth separation at 2n+1 require their stated nonempty-source, positive-coordinate, common-policy and full-support hypotheses. A three-dimensional four-query/three-route control prevents an unqualified dimensional extension. Exact minima and a fixed finite interior experiment are incomparable under exact common Markov reconstruction: absolute continuity obstructs one direction, while finite-alphabet reverse domination versus an unbounded likelihood ratio obstructs the other. A deterministic fibre example alone would not establish the stochastic claim. [S0088]

The full lower skyline retains the undominated threshold points. For an ordered skyline z_1,…,z_k from N independent draws, the density has the form (N)_k∏f(z_i) μ(D)^(N−k), where D is the dominated region consistent with that skyline. There is no extra division by k! in this ordered convention. Given the visible labels and points, hidden draws have the truncated conditional law on D. The exact K=m stratum is alternative-only and has probability p_n strictly between zero and 1/m!. A support-only waiting method therefore has mean greater than m! under the alternative and does not halt under the baseline. On the common strata, the conditional KL divergences are finite and positive; forward KL for the full skyline is infinite because of the singular stratum. [S0416] [S0121]

The skyline count already improves the independent-vector upper bound. Its mean gap is (H_n−1)/(n²−1) for n>1 and (ζ(2)−1)/2 at n=1. V003706.text: Common original provision and the Arabic unity argument

V003707.text: AI authored research by dot powered by OpenAI

V003708.text: Final research report version 1 dated 6 October 2026

V003710.text: The cumulative argument now gives sufficient defeasible rational warrant for one complete original source of the actual productively connected field under consideration. This judgement rests on explicit metaphysical and evaluative premises. It does not follow from a bare necessary being, a prediction that rival wills would disagree, or connectedness alone. A reasoned contrary assessment remains reasonable disagreement.

V003711.text: The central question is whether connected reality can have several ultimate suppliers, even if they always agree and none borrows its standing power. Two different proposals now receive separate treatment. Differentiated contributors divide the original provision of a result. Primitive double sufficiency instead alleges that two concurrent unborrowed exercises each supply the whole result without needing the other. The maker-and-preserver comparison addresses the first proposal more directly. It does not by itself exclude the second.

V003712.text: The revised conclusion therefore makes two additional judgements visible. Causal nonduplication says that distinct genuine original contributions do distinct productive work, rather than primitively duplicating the same entire production in the same respect. The stronger source-mode norm says that complete unborrowed provision is the fitting mode of a qualified perfect original’s actual productive role. I accept both defeasibly on their separate positive rationales. Neither is a neutral theorem, and causal nonduplication alone does not establish common field coverage.

V003713.text: The broader Arabic reading improves how those premises are understood. Speech, temporal succession, responsive action, remedies and testimony constrain the concepts used in the short unity argument. The new gains are comprehension, explicit warrant appraisal and synthesis of substantially known sources. They are not invented historical discoveries or fresh formal science.

V003714.text: The result excludes an independently original co-contributor within the warranted field. It does not establish numerical uniqueness of every necessary reality beyond it, authenticate an actual revelation or make every created message the source’s own assertion. The report also records a positive but bounded intentional-attestation route and the narrower outcome of the al-Walid case.

V003715.text: This is AI-authored Nineteenth research by dot, powered by OpenAI. The finite selected reading and reflective phases are complete at the scopes reported below. No external human-specialist endorsement, new kernel proof or repository adoption is claimed. Adopted main remains 19de267c, tree 08a6452e, through final Sixth. Open unmerged PR30 remains fd0903d9, tree e7b47c7e, through T16. These separate boundaries were verified at 14:19:58 UTC on 6 October 2026.

V003716.text: What was already established and what changes

V003717.text: The retained starting point is stronger than an unspecified unexplained fact. Under the concrete whole-existence account, complete original provision of received productive reality warrants an actual original bearer. Separately defended arguments support that same bearer’s necessary existence, essential whole-existence independence, relevant knowledge and wisdom, eligible unrestricted standing productive power, and source-owned veracity. Necessary existence alone was not treated as supplying the entire profile.

V003718.text: Whole-field original completion and one-bearer common coverage are different achievements. The former requires an adequate actual original basis for the complete received field. It did not already exclude a plural original basis. The present judgement adds causal nonduplication, a stronger perfection of actual sourcehood and faithful mediate attribution to the independently warranted field premises.

V003719.text: The earlier full Minhāj assessment already considered cooperation and foreknowledge. It recognised complete versus partial token production, accompaniment versus productive supply, and standing power versus fitting exercise. Those remain valid. It would misstate the history to claim that Ibn Taymiyya simply overlooked agreement. The newly examined Jāmiʿ passages add primary support for distinguishing jointly required acts from reciprocal supply of powers or intentions. [9]

V003720.text: The first Nineteenth appraisal gave positive weight to actual source perfection. A subsequent scope check correctly identified a gap: the maker-and-preserver comparison and a complete historical record did not alone exclude primitive nonexclusive double sufficiency. The current appraisal preserves that correction. It now explicitly accepts causal nonduplication on its own rationale and affirms the cumulative field conclusion under the stronger source-mode and field premises. A change in sufficient-warrant judgement does not make the intervening objection mistaken.

V003721.text: Three propositions must be separated. A could produce an effect if B were absent. A’s actual exercise supplies sufficient efficacy without receiving completion from B. A is the exclusive exhaustive actual original producer of that effect. The primitive double-sufficiency proposal attributes the second to A and B concurrently while denying the third of either. It specifies distinct actual exercises, one concrete effect, no missing portion, no idle backup and no reduced effort.

V003722.text: That proposal has not thereby been shown possible. But its stated content differs from ordinary cooperation, unused ability and merely matching alternative outcomes. If A alone actually produces the whole, B does not also produce it. This contradiction is sound once solitary production is granted. It does not, by itself, establish that nonexclusive sufficient efficacy means production alone.

V003723.text: The maker-and-preserver comparison evaluates provision needing foreign completion. Primitive duplication purports to place both exercises on the unborrowed side of that comparison. Recording both in an exhaustive history would establish divided attribution if both are genuine; it would not prove that either needed the other’s completion. The earlier favourable appraisal had not separately earned this extension. Its scope correction is retained. [3, 7, pp. 134–154]

V003725.text: The additional principle accepted here is causal nonduplication, abbreviated CND. It concerns entire original production of the same concrete contribution in the same causal respect. It is not a prohibition of multiple sufficient conditions, reasons, descriptions or levels of agency. It allows real secondary agency and cooperation through differentiated work.

V003726.text: Its positive rationale is productive individuation. Genuine additional production has determinate causal content: a further source supplies work, a requisite, material, reinforcement, receptivity or preservation. A second contribution need not add a visible quantity. Conversely, an unused alternative supplies no second actual production. Darʾ’s examples of bodily powers, a thrown stone, air, food and receptive capacity distinguish these roles more finely than a coarse endpoint description does. [10]

V003727.text: Determinate content does not analytically entail nonduplication. The nonduplicative organisation of entire production is the substantive judgement being made. It assumes neither microphysical atomism nor one uniquely computable decomposition of every process. The examples illuminate how genuine causal plurality is individuated; they are not an exhaustive induction over every possible case.

V003728.text: The primitive rival asks whether two complete original productive relations can both obtain without differentiated work. A reason to count both as actual entire productions could be metaphysical rather than mechanical. Merely repeating the two source labels, however, does not supply it. I find the account connecting actuality, determinate contribution and complete production sufficiently illuminating for defeasible acceptance. Explanatory economy reinforces that rationale. Absence of a demonstrated rival removes one potential defeater; it does not itself create positive warrant. A persuasive conceptual criticism could defeat the rationale without producing a physical counterexample.

V003729.text: There is a genuine difference from original existential adequacy. A wholly received account otherwise leaves an original-provision shortfall. Primitive duplication alleges surplus original supply. Bare adequacy therefore discriminates less directly against duplication. The CND judgement has its own rationale and remains more contestable than the whole-alone contradiction. Suspension is reasonable disagreement, not evidence that every dissenter misunderstands the words.

V003730.text: The source’s criticism of an empty “one from one” principle is a further control. Asfahānī pp. 462–467 allows several differentiated created factors and demands intelligible causal content. One cannot infer one original producer merely from the numerical unity of the effect. Ordinary plurality and duplication of entire original production must be distinguished. [7]

V003731.text: Independence and the perfection of actual exercise

V003732.text: Standing power and fitting exercise answer different questions. Nonexercise does not establish incapacity, while intact capacity does not vindicate every use. A unity argument fails if it identifies nonexercise with lost power. An objection to the stronger perfection argument fails if it treats the retained faculty as sufficient for fitting action.

V003733.text: The source-owned veracity appraisal already recognises that distinction: a knowingly false assertion can be defective while knowledge and expressive faculties remain. Unity is not deduced by analogy from veracity. Its action-specific rationale concerns adequate unborrowed original provision of a concrete produced result.

V003734.text: The stronger source-mode premise is separate from CND. A qualified essentially independent and practically perfect original’s actual productive role should possess unborrowed adequate original provision, rather than depend on an irreducibly foreign original positive resource. I judge the fuller mode fitting to original practical perfection, rather than merely one optional larger accomplishment. The maker-and-preserver comparison, the realised-efficacy account and the broader intrinsic-perfection rationale support this judgement. [2, 3, 7, pp. 507–508, 532–536]

V003735.text: The distinction is clearest in a transformation. A may supply its entire intrinsic transformative exercise while B supplies the material. The causal description establishes incomplete original coverage of the resulting composition. It does not alone establish that A’s chosen role is deficient. That evaluative conclusion comes from the stronger source-mode premise. The word “undertaking” must not hide a prior assignment of the whole composite role to A.

V003736.text: A critic can accordingly ask why a freely chosen less comprehensive role could not be fitting. The critic need not demonstrate a good uniquely requiring an original peer before that question has force. My acceptance rests on the positive excellence of adequate unborrowed provision in the agency actually exercised, under the accepted original and practical-perfection framework. Absence of a peer-essential good is at most secondary support.

V003737.text: This norm concerns the mode of actual provision. It does not require creating every possible object, preserving every effect forever or maximising activity irrespective of wisdom. Selective creation, properly timed action and genuine derived cooperation can preserve the mode. If the stronger norm is judged insufficient, CND alone does not rescue common-field coverage.

V003738.text: The relational-good objection also earns a real control. A shared process can benefit participants in ways that a matching isolated endpoint does not preserve; Asfahānī pp. 422–423 expressly makes this point about means. The examined medieval perfect-love comparison likewise values real personal participation. It does not establish several independently original causal suppliers: personal distinction, equal relevant excellence and independent original provenance are different claims. This leaves no newly established source-mode counterexample, but supplies no second proof of the norm either. [7, 13]

V003739.text: The source mode reconstruction and its textual tension

V003741.text: The evidence requires four distinctions. Essential standing perfections, such as the independently defended life, knowledge, power and wisdom, characterise the concrete necessary bearer. An essential original mode concerns how the source’s agency is possessed and exercised without foreign original completion. The genus of activity concerns continuing or successive agency as a kind. A token act is this particular realised exercise at its fitting occasion.

V003742.text: These levels cannot be collapsed. An essential mode can constrain every fitting exercise without making each exercise a timeless constituent of the bearer. Similarly, an enduring kind of activity does not make one particular act beginningless, nor make the abstract kind a separate productive source. Temporal newness does not by itself prove a choice among alternative complete histories with all complete grounds held fixed.

V003743.text: The retained Asfahānī commentary supplies a direct control. In the inspected edition, Ibn Taymiyya allows the prior absence of a particular act to be fitting and its later occurrence to be the perfection appropriate to its time:

V003744.text: بل كان الكمال عدمه قبل وقت وجوده، ووجوده وقت وجوده

V003745.text: English translation by dot: “Rather, perfection consisted in its absence before the time of its existence, and in its existence at the time of its existence.” [7, p. 411]

V003746.text: The surrounding pages praise actually performing the loved act at the loved time in the loved manner. They therefore support neither eternal-token maximalism nor a reduction of perfection to indefinitely idle ability. They also distinguish achieving a loved end through one’s own act from being completed by an independent supplier. Where the text invokes sole origination to explain that difference, its universal source scope must be acknowledged rather than used as an independent proof of that same scope. [7, pp. 411–419]

V003747.text: What the compressed Minhāj argument leaves to explain

V003748.text: Minhāj 2:162–170 explains the existential inference most clearly for inseparable perfections included in the necessary self. At 2:174 it distinguishes necessities of existence from incidental states. The sphere example then concerns unchosen constitution, while 2:180 expressly includes actual conditioned efficacy. At 2:182–183 the discussion returns to a general argument that perfection necessarily belongs to the necessary being. The text does not there separately spell out how every renewed voluntary token fits the transition. [2]

V003749.text: The tension is real. The passage’s universal wording and its application to actual efficacy place pressure on a reading which restricts its direct existential inference to inseparable standing attributes. The wider action doctrine, however, prevents simply treating every token perfection as an eternally possessed essential constituent. Both pieces of evidence must remain visible. The retained witness’s apparent missing negation on Asfahānī p. 412 and defective ending on p. 667 are not silently repaired or made load-bearing; the clear proper-time distinction on pp. 411 and 413 supplies its own support.

V003750.text: The present reconstruction therefore distinguishes a source-owned thesis from the particular form of its justification. Independence in actions and effects is an explicit authorial claim. Local closure of the genuine productive requisites of an undertaken effect is a faithful but nontrivial rational application. Grounding that closure in an essential original mode, instead of inferring received whole existence from any received token state, is an inferential clarification or repair across passages. It is not a derivation explicitly completed in Minhāj 2:183.

V003751.text: This distinction prevents a reversed implication. If a bearer’s whole existence is received, its intrinsic concrete instantiation is received in that existential respect. It does not follow that reception in any one state proves receipt of the bearer’s entire existence. The stronger exclusion needs the additional claim that foreign completion of the relevant actual productive role violates an essential original perfection. Its immediate conclusion is incompatibility with that mode. Ibn Taymiyya’s stronger conclusion concerning necessary self-existence remains recorded at the stronger constitutive scope his argument asserts.

V003752.text: The repair has genuine source support, but its central classification is not thereby self-evident. It still requires the positive appraisal of actual original sourcehood. The intrinsic-act/material distinction is relevant precisely because not every condition of an external composite effect is automatically an intrinsic perfection received by its agent. The current affirmative judgement credits complete original provision as a governing source-mode excellence while acknowledging that this is interpretatively and philosophically substantive.

V003753.text: How original provision follows through created causes

V003755.text: A created agent can own an act proximally and morally. An original source can supply the productive reality through which that agent acts. A source can also be the complete original provider of the resulting effect. These are three different relations. The second does not automatically imply the first or the third.

V003756.text: Suppose A originally supplies productive reality actually employed by a derived agent H in producing a result r. A belongs in r’s actual original productive account, even when H genuinely performs the act. H’s exercise does not turn its received powers into an autonomous original stock. Mere temporal precedence, knowledge, concurrence or spatial proximity would not establish this attribution; actual productive ancestry does.

V003757.text: Complete original provision requires more. The present argument combines that genuine mediate contribution with the additional source-mode perfection principle. If some of r’s actual original basis comes from an independent peer, the original source’s role remains foreign-completed through the intermediary. The intermediary changes the immediate agent. It does not convert the peer’s original contribution into A’s provision or remove A’s actual contribution from the account.

V003758.text: A separate demonstration that A intentionally owns each token as its own act is therefore unnecessary for this productive attribution. Identifying a dependent state presently supplied by A is a useful sufficient test, but it is not the only bridge. Requiring intentional ownership of every mediated effect would apply the wrong kind of ownership to a claim about original productive resources.

V003759.text: This correction does not remove the need for intentional ownership where it actually matters. H’s assertion remains H’s assertion unless there is additional warrant for A’s own assertion or attestation. Causal provision of the powers involved does not make every creaturely representation a truthful communication by the source. The same distinction protects genuine subordinate agency from being erased by common original creation. Ibn al-Qayyim expressly allows real created efficacy while distinguishing it from coequal intrinsically possessed original powers. [6]

V003761.text: Directly shared production presents the simplest case. If an actual effect requires original inputs from two independent sources, its complete original basis includes both. The separately appraised source-mode norm rules out the qualified perfect source’s foreign-completed role there; causal accounting alone does not make that normative judgement. Calling each intention internally complete does not supply the missing original basis of the whole actual product.

V003762.text: A later modifier gives a second case. Suppose B changes material originally supplied by A. If B’s actual transformation requires that material and its relevant receptivity, B’s current productive role has a foreign original requisite. B’s unused ability to originate different material does not supply the actual material. Nothing in this analysis requires A to have intended its earlier product to remain unchanged forever.

V003763.text: Where two created processes interact, the same test applies to their original resources. A proposed division cannot confine each original to its earliest isolated output and then leave the later mixed result outside any original account. The derivative powers still have actual provenance when they operate. Their meeting does not generate an unexplained new original supply.

V003764.text: The test remains typed and occurrence-sensitive. An earlier act, its produced situation and a later act by the same bearer are not one event. A prior-created situation can occasion a later wise exercise without thereby producing the source’s existence or original power. Responsive causal roles may overlap; an intelligible reason or object is not thereby proved nonproductive. Collapsing all these occurrences into a single bearer-level node would manufacture a cycle that the account does not assert.

V003765.text: Similarly, a condition already included in the same source’s original provision does not introduce a foreign original peer. It need not be causally or explanatorily inert. Conversely, describing a genuinely foreign productive input as an “occasion” does not erase its origin. The relevant explanatory role and respect must be established; no single vocabulary rule about “cause” or “condition” can do that work.

V003766.text: From local coverage to the connected field

V003767.text: At a real productive crossing between purported original domains, the common effect’s account includes productive, material or preserving resources from both sides. Faithful mediate attribution retains those original contributions. The source-mode perfection principle then excludes a qualified perfect source’s foreign-completed role at that crossing. The stronger local-coverage norm excludes differentiated foreign completion, while CND excludes alleged primitive duplication of entire original production. With both premises, source identity propagates through the genuinely connected field.

V003768.text: Connectedness therefore propagates coverage; it does not supply the local requirement. In the retained Sixth architecture, actual scope and faithful strict productive ancestry belong to P0 and P1, local complete coverage to P2, and the relevant connectedness to P3. The separate P4 interpretation ensures that a graph’s reflexive coverage is not mistaken for an actual productive act. The broader disposition’s original-completion principle also called P1 is a different premise from Sixth’s ancestry P1.

V003769.text: The Nineteenth judgement gives substantive support to local complete coverage P2 through the additional actual-source perfection, CND and mediate-attribution appraisals. It does not rename P2 as a consequence of connectedness. The actual productive witness and the complete original account are still needed, including all relevant branches and history-inclusive contributions.

V003770.text: An infinite field or an infinite subordinate ancestry is not automatically excluded. The argument does not require a first temporal event or global well-foundedness. It requires actual original provision throughout the relevant account. A lone root beside an unsupported derivative branch cannot satisfy that requirement. Nor can a coarse endpoint description delete real contributors merely because another possible history would have reached a similar endpoint. Retaining contributors in the history does not itself prove that primitive duplication is impossible; CND supplies that separate judgement.

V003771.text: The bearer qualification is schematic. The earlier identification of a bearer with essential whole-existence originality and the relevant perfections does not exempt an alleged second bearer that genuinely satisfies the same conditions. Equally, an unexplained local contribution, efficient-only nonreceipt or the label “original” does not establish those qualifications. A genuine holistic original bearer also does not make every component independently original.

V003772.text: The substantive dissent and the standard of warrant

V003773.text: The adverse perfection appraisal accepts that intact standing power does not vindicate every exercise, chosen reception remains reception, and the maker-and-preserver has the fuller role in the stated respect. It also accepts the distinction between derivative causes and independent original partners. It withholds sufficient warrant for treating that fuller role as the required mode of every qualified original exercise.

V003774.text: Its question is substantive. Does superior performance of a complete-producer role show that every perfect original must undertake that role, rather than some otherwise fitting contribution? Success alone does not make an act fitting, but comparative fullness alone does not automatically make the fuller role obligatory. The proper-time and relational-good passages make this issue sharper. The present affirmative judgement supplies its own positive evaluative rationale while preserving that dissent.

V003775.text: The separate adverse CND appraisal correctly distinguishes needed completion from alleged unneeded concurrence. Ordinary examples display differentiated work, and the whole-alone contradiction already assumes solitary production. A critic can reasonably judge the positive individuation rationale insufficient without producing a possible plural universe. The current acceptance disagrees about its evidential force; it does not refute or withdraw the dissent.

V003776.text: The standard remains sufficient defeasible rational belief, as in the earlier necessity, original-completion, essential-mode and veracity appraisals. A premise does not fail merely because it is substantive and disputed. Conversely, authorial endorsement or usefulness to a valid reconstruction does not establish its truth. The positive content, proper application and actual objections determine the appraisal. Different premises can receive different confidence under the same standard.

V003777.text: The broader reading reinforces that discipline. Asfahānī p. 47 asks a presented proof to establish its premises and answer objections; p. 133 permits genuinely evident premises to remain unstated. Pages 638–639 distinguish someone’s actual grounds of knowledge from the argument they can articulate, while allowing multiple knowledge routes. These are compatible claims. A flaw in one public argument need not defeat its conclusion or every person’s knowledge. Unspecified other routes do not repair that particular flaw. [7]

V003778.text: Explanatory economy supplies supplementary support. Several original wills need a determinate allocation of contributions, not merely agreement on a shared end. One source avoids that further matching problem. But the exclusion of original deficiencies is a consequence of the same accepted source-mode norm, not a further independent confirmation. Repetition by several authors or assessments is not additional proof. The report claims warranted bounded belief, not universally compulsory demonstration.

V003779.text: Standing power and source sensitive targets

V003780.text: The actual-source route does not settle every issue in the domain of standing power. An ordinary source-neutral result, a token referred to by its actual producer, a history containing a specified original contribution and another subject’s intrinsic act are different targets.

V003781.text: An arbitrary source label cannot exclude an ordinary eligible result from unrestricted power. But a history expressly containing H’s unreceived original contribution changes if that contribution is replaced or made received. This conditional observation does not prove the history possible; it identifies relational content a power claim must preserve.

V003782.text: Performing H’s willing also differs from causing H to will. Genuine secondary agency already permits an act to belong to a creature while its original productive reality is supplied by another. Ownership alone does not exempt an act from causal production.

V003783.text: For an essentially original H, the further issue is whether foreign production of its intrinsic efficacy contradicts its original mode, and whether that very act is an eligible transferable object of every other qualified source’s power. If the universal domain includes it with its relevant identity and original mode unchanged, the incompatibility with a second qualified original must be honoured. Nonexercise does not dissolve a conflict in the powers attributed.

V003784.text: The retained power rationale does not unambiguously settle that stronger domain. A principled exclusion requires an independently warranted identity or original-agency relation; an inclusion must preserve the target’s constitutive relations. The common-source judgement instead rests on the explicitly appraised CND and actual-source perfection premises, not on silently expanding standing power.

V003785.text: Actual causal accounting also differs from essentiality of origin across alternatives. Explaining who actually produced an effect does not prove that the same effect could never have had another origin. The field argument needs the complete actual account without importing a general theory of transworld origin-essentiality.

V003786.text: The conclusion reaches the actual productive field for which the original-resource account and real connectedness are warranted. It is stronger than finding an unrelated necessary being or a root somewhere in one ancestry. It identifies one complete original provider of that field and excludes an independent co-original contributor within it.

V003787.text: The conclusion does not by itself identify every necessary or original reality outside that field with this source. Absolute supremacy supplies a distinct wider route, but its unrestricted comparative scope needs its own warrant. A separate activity-kind appraisal gives positive grounds against a permanently productively idle qualified duplicate: indefinite nonexercise omits an excellence different from this optional token’s absence. That judgement does not exclude a genuinely disconnected active original, and is not itself a consequence of field connectedness. An unproved out-of-field rival is not thereby established as possible, actual or equally credible. These limits should neither erase the field-wide result nor turn it into an unrestricted uniqueness claim.

V003788.text: The same-bearer mapping matters downstream. If the bearer fixed by the earlier attribute arguments is an actual independent original contributor to this same field, the exclusion of a second such contributor identifies it with the common source. If its participation is not established, two existential statements alone do not identify their witnesses. The mapping must be shown or the accepted attribute rationale applied to the suitably qualified common source.

V003790.text: Avenue 1 gains common-source identification for the relevant received reality and its actual productive support. A correction or cognitive exercise within the warranted field need no longer be left with an unidentified original provider on the ground that the earlier witness might be only one among several originals. This is the actual increment; the minimal necessary bearer, whole-field original completion and essential-independence judgements were already affirmative.

V003791.text: Common coverage does not retrospectively complete every earlier route. Sixth’s source and productive-act conditions, Ninth’s exact E and E* targets and its HistoryComplete, UnborrowedActs and ProductiveWitness distinctions, and Eleventh’s proper-act and composition accounting retain their own work. Nineteenth supplies a further metaphysical application of local complete coverage rather than a fresh proof of those structural results.

V003792.text: The earlier full-determination, qualified-origin-modal and intrinsic-prior-ownership analyses keep their exact inferential limits. Necessary existence does not become necessary creation. Local determination by complete will and power does not settle why this whole history occurs, whether alternative complete histories are possible, or whether the total history is intrinsically necessary. A beginningless succession supplies neither a first act nor an answer to those separate modal questions.

V003793.text: Other incomplete bridges also remain incomplete on their own terms: E_A achievement preservation and RP5, the qualifying cone for a local original participant, actual disjointness of purported contributors, empirical mechanism and calibration for stochastic support, and the separate all-parts or fusion argument in the Koons totality route. Their smaller constructive results are preserved. A successful common-source route does not furnish missing premises to every earlier route, nor establish a generic transition from any noncausal explanation to a concrete efficient creator.

V003795.text: Avenue 2 gains identification of the previously defended truthful source with the common original provider, subject to the same-bearer mapping. It does not first establish essential T0. Seventeenth already accepted exceptionless source-owned veracity under its practical-perfection and integrity premises without requiring strong P2 or unrestricted numerical uniqueness.

V003796.text: T0 concerns the source’s own genuine contextual assertion. D1 still requires an actual communicative occurrence, intentional source ownership or attestation, and determinate content. D2 still requires an adequate recipient route to those facts and an assessment of relevant defeaters. A token’s public assertion of its own source or purpose cannot supply its missing attribution. Silence, quotation, fiction and nonassertoric acts remain distinct.

V003797.text: Common creation therefore gives neither universal truth of created beliefs nor a truthful-message status to every event in the field. Causing or permitting a creature’s false report is different from asserting that report as one’s own. The complete-profile R_G/N bridge also remains unearned by unity, although the independent owned-integrity route need not wait for that bridge.

V003798.text: The absence of an independent original pursuer within the field becomes available at its proper causal scope. It does not show that every good end has a truthful interchangeable means. The accepted direct veracity rationale did not depend on that claim, and the unity result does not substitute it for the source’s own-speech integrity argument.
