V003820.text: Objective fittingness and the scope of authority

Given an actual Creator with substantive essential wisdom, the source account explains objective creaturely fittingness. Real natures, powers, relations, benefits and impairments are originated and ordered through fitting purposes. Cognitive capacities can give access to those goods. Relationality is not subjectivism: what damages a creature can depend on its nature and circumstances without depending on an observer’s preference.

A wider wise purpose need not erase local harm. A condition may genuinely impair a creature while being permitted for another good. Arabic Asfahani printed pp. 419–420 / PDF pp. 519–520 also distinguishes creative willing from love and command. Occurrence alone does not establish approval or permission; noncompliance does not itself defeat a command’s governing purpose. These distinctions make the account informative about actual relations rather than approving every event under an unspecified redescription.

Asfahani printed p. 226 / PDF p. 233 endorses a combined account of value and command. A deed can have value in its own features, a command can disclose it, and commanding can introduce a further wise practical relation. The newly read Arabic p. 429 / PDF p. 529 grounds freedom from rightful reproach in complete knowledge, wisdom, mercy and justice rather than merely domination, will and power. It directly reinforces the positive case for rightful governance beyond superior force.

The account can support determinate local norms when the creature, respect, circumstances and evidence are identified. A warranted correction need not await an exhaustive unique metaethic. Not every local benefit creates a duty for every agent, however. A claim of divine direction does not authenticate its speaker, and permission to believe a proposition does not establish authority to govern another person or implement it.

Al-Ujayri distinguishes goodness without belief in God from goodness existing without God at printed pp. 25–45 / PDF pp. 29–49. His converse inference from objective norms to an absolute personal Maker remains underargued in the inspected passages. Objective correctness and a concrete necessary producer do not become identical because both are called absolute. This limitation leaves the constructive forward account under the wise-Creator grant intact.

The focused authority appraisal develops an inherited command-dependent distinction by bringing these supplied arguments together. Oneness printed pp. 7–8 and 11–16 / PDF pp. 14–15 and 18–23 joins sourcehood and beneficence to fitting response; Asfahani printed pp. 218 and 221–228 / PDF pp. 225 and 228–235 makes wisdom govern direction. Answering this actual wise giver can constitute acknowledgement and cooperation beyond an act’s independent merit or the receipt of accurate advice.

A binding local conclusion assumes actual rightful obligatory force and adequate warrant for truthful practical communication in this relation. Neither follows from imperative grammar, alleged authority or generic wisdom. Once those facts are warranted, the recipient can be warranted to obey without reconstructing every underlying purpose. A command may specify an owed response; causal ownership or benefaction alone does not establish unlimited lawmaking power. The affirmative source-veracity appraisal can supply its integrity premise when its same-bearer conditions are warranted. It does not establish this token’s authorship, obligatory force, addressee or content by itself.

The authority result supports relational reasons and qualified local duty when actual rightful force, attribution, content and communicative warrant hold. The Hoover check leaves three cited bodies unread despite limited corroboration from a distinct later article. The continuing unity and veracity disagreements remain precise. These limits do not reopen the closed placement inquiry.

Avenue 3 gains application of the previously defended wise Creator–creature relation to the connected actual recipients, powers and relations. That account includes substantive fittingness, creaturely fulfilment and impairment, and access to such goods. The gain is more than a name for causal provenance, but it depends on the retained wisdom and normative premises as well as common-source identification.

Efficient production, apprehension, intentional constitution and intrinsic normative character remain different relations. Unity does not identify every normative truth with the producer. Local objective correction and fittingness also need not await an exhaustive theory of ultimate origin. The earlier mental-agency and natural-standard findings keep their own limited achievements.

The prior authority assessment permits a positive command-dependent relational reason and a warranted local binding direction where rightful obligatory address is actually established. Common creation strengthens the identification of the original and continuing giver. Causal ownership alone does not establish unlimited legislative jurisdiction, deliberate legitimate reliance, every requisite precaution or fair coordination. Gratitude supplies no automatic infinite debt, and manufacturing a lack of alternatives creates no authority.

For a bare imperative or an attempted duty-constituting directive, authentic source attribution or an apparent presentation as obligatory is insufficient by itself. Its force must be interpreted, and legitimate obligation-imposing standing must be exercised within scope. A request can be optional. Repeating a directive’s authority claim does not establish those conditions. The wider domain of a general right to specify duties remains a distinct question.

An authenticated source-owned assertion of an obligation is different. Suppose its determinate contextual content is “recipient r is obligated to do a in context c”, and the retained relevant-knowledge and essential owned-veracity premises apply to that same source. Those premises warrant the normative proposition through testimony. A second independent proof of that very obligation or its underlying jurisdiction is unnecessary. The actual obligation is not dispensed with: its obtaining is precisely what the warranted truthful assertion establishes. Such a report need not itself create the duty or identify its ultimate ground.

This transmission of warrant still requires independent authentication of source ownership, contextual content, recipient, time and conditions. The disputed token cannot bootstrap its own attribution. If an authenticated assertion accompanies a constitutive directive and truthfully reports the resulting obligation, the assertion can warrant that obligation without first completing a general theory of legislative authority. Particular implementation, channel identity, feasibility, safety and any further permissions remain distinct from the content warranted.

A Commentary on the Creed of Asfahani v2.3: Ibn Taymiyyah, translated by Wordsmiths, Sapience Publishing, first edition 2024; 248 PDF pages. The translation selectively combines two Arabic editions. The creed, commentary and translator’s additions must be distinguished. Printed Arabic-numbered page plus seven gives the PDF page.

Ibn Taymiyyah on the Oneness of Allah: a 55-page English excerpt attributed to Ibn Taymiyya’s Asfahani commentary. Its translator, editor, publisher, date and precise Arabic edition are unidentified in the supplied file. Main text: printed 1–42, PDF 8–49; graphical appendix: PDF 51–55.

Printed p. 226 / PDF p. 233 supports a combined account of value and command: deeds have their own evaluatively relevant features, which instruction can disclose, and command can introduce a wise practical relation. This does not establish unrestricted lawmaking authority. A particular directive’s rightful force and adequate communicative integrity still require warrant.

For norms, objective fittingness and essential practical wisdom support a constructive account. The newer primary speech argument adds the distinction between created defects and defects inhering in the source’s own assertion. The main report accepts exceptionless source-owned veracity under its stated same-bearer perfection premises, with substantive dissent preserved. Authenticating revelation, identifying content and establishing a particular directive’s authority remain separate tasks.

V005904.text: The formal conclusion and its original scientific anchors retain their checked interpretation. A global empty extension separates persistent capacity from actual activity under the reduced assumptions. It does not preserve the stronger always-active or anti-inactivity premises supported at the audited source scope. General activity is not eternal instantiation of every kind; a token's ending or one kind's absence is not total inactivity. A renewed intrinsic act is not, by definition, a created bearer or externally received perfection.

V005929.text: - **Safadiyya, SF-S001-L0070–L0085; L0266–L0276; SF-S002-L0519–L0534.** Post-completion contextual reread. S001-L0073 distinguishes unrestricted activity, a particular effect's production, and producing everything; L0077 distinguishes type from particular acts. L0082 distinguishes successive acts and products; L0084 says affirming the type does not establish one particular eternal act or product. L0273 expressly separates the divine act subsisting in him from the product separate from him, while treating creatures' acts as created and genuinely theirs. S002-L0521–L0527 discusses successive particular operations versus making original creative efficacy dependent on another creative efficacy. L0529–L0530 explicitly reports that divine attributes/acts subsisting in him are not his created products across the compared accounts, including the account of successive individual acts with an enduring type. L0531–L0533 then separates positions about particular “kun” utterances. The reported alternatives must not be combined into one undifferentiated doctrine. This directly supports the act/product category correction, not total cessation of all emergent kinds.

V005930.text: - **Sharḥ al-ʿAqīda al-Aṣbahāniyya, printed65–68,96–99,103–104; PDF165–168,196–199,203–204.** Direct reread of retained images, main prose and visible relevant apparatus. Pages65–68 distinguish external existential need from qualification and concomitance;96–99 distinguish mutual conditions from efficient causal dependence and an actually qualified self from an abstract bare existent. Pages103–104 distinguish each particular's necessity from the shared abstract description. These controls block deriving a second extramental necessary individual merely by naming a common type. They do not prove an empty-genus scenario or classify every voluntary act by themselves.

The ground's existence and power are explicit interpretation inputs, never inferred from persistence of possibility.

V008227.text: These differences prevent false multiplication of evidence. Repeated discussion of one Ibn Taymiyya passage in a thesis, anthology and modern exposition can deepen interpretation without becoming three independent historical witnesses. An editorial model of religious warrant can be explicitly conditional even where the underlying historical account affirms actual recognition of the Creator. Both claims should remain intact.

V008228.text: The source guide records concrete local corrections. In Asfahani, an effect's sufficiency through its complete cause must not become efficient self-creation; susceptibility to nonexistence must not become actual nonexistence alone. Translator note 58 confuses a deductive indicant with an invalid converse. In Incoherence, the combination-lock wording and numbered-needle calculation need correction. These are bounded findings about particular English passages and comparisons. They neither invalidate unrelated arguments nor establish globally defective translation.

V008229.text: This standard permits determinate positive judgements alongside remaining disagreement. Ordinary testimonial belief may be warranted without a uniquely correct theory of testimony. A local wrong may be recognised without a complete metaethic. A conditional attribute conclusion may be established even while an upstream existence argument remains disputed. Each result receives the credit its own premises and evidence support.

V008230.text: The historical framing needs equal precision. Sixth section 2 already contained and evaluated the stronger source claim, including positive intrinsic sufficiency and noninferential recognition of need and independence. Sixth section 7 used a narrower explanatory-appropriateness reconstruction together with an additional explanatory-exhaustiveness commitment whose warrant it separately questioned. The present work re-evaluates the stronger material in fuller context. It does not discover a wholly missing premise or correct an earlier programme that knew only the weaker formulation.

V008231.text: Actual received activity warrants actual productive suppliers with real efficacy. This can be known without recovering an exhaustive causal history. Asfahani printed pp. 22–27 / PDF pp. 29–34 and Oneness printed pp. 17–22 / PDF pp. 24–29 give that judgement positive content. A receiver is not powerless merely because its possession of power is received.

V008232.text: The stronger original-completion principle addresses the complete existential provision of the actual received field, including the actuality through which its productive resources act. An exhaustive account cannot discharge that target solely by presupposing the same received actuality throughout. Passing to another receiver supplies a real local explanation without changing its received manner of possession. Original actuality provides a positively different existential basis, not merely a shorter causal chain.

V008233.text: I judge this principle sufficiently supported for defeasible rational belief. It preserves the whole-existence target, distinguishes intermediate contribution from original provision, and gives a non-presupposing mode of adequacy real explanatory work. Infinitely many subordinate effects or relations remain compatible with original completion. The judgement is not a theorem from local causality or a demand that every fact have a necessitating explanation. Sixth already contained the stronger rationale; its present appraisal is more favourable, not historically new.

V008234.text: The initial completion review withheld this verdict because a supplied dependent remains dependent, and an active infinitary proposal gives real local suppliers throughout. A subsequent challenge exposed the objection’s insufficient force at whole-field scope. Continuing receivedness concerns beneficiaries after supply; the affirmative never requires them to become original. It does not show that their exhaustive existential account can rely solely on received actuality throughout. The original reviewer accepted that correction. The negative assessment is preserved as superseded, rather than portrayed as continuing dissent or silent initial agreement.

V008235.text: The explanatory type remains a separate question. A fixed plurality’s joint existence can be contingent if one of those very beings could be absent; all need not be absent together, and no new aggregate is required. But contingency plus generic sufficient reason for facts does not alone identify a concrete efficient cause. If reception includes all existential derivation, a genuinely autonomous noncausal ground counts as original in that broad respect. Identifying such an ultimate resource with an efficient Creator needs a further bridge. Restricting receipt to efficient production cannot silently yield complete ontological nonderivation.

V008236.text: Under the additional productive-resource and bearer ontology, real original efficacy requires actual concrete reality possessing or constituting it. Yet joint completion does not itself identify one individually complete common bearer. A plurality, a real holistic source and one universally complete individual remain distinct. These distinctions establish neither a rival’s metaphysical possibility nor equal credibility.

V008237.text: The minimal actual-witness question must now be distinguished from common coverage. Under the adopted whole-existence and qualified-bearer commitments, it is already warranted; it does not await a name or unique identification. Originality of one local power alone remains insufficient. The next section states the resource-to-bearer step and resulting Necessary Being conclusion. Where the complete Necessary Creator is granted, its downstream consequences also remain available immediately.

V008238.text: The actual witness and the Necessary Being conclusion

V008239.text: The accepted completion argument supplies original existential actuality relevant to the actual receiving target. Under the adopted concrete productive/bearer account, this warrants some actual particular whole-existence original bearer. An existential witness need not be named, uniquely identified or individually complete for every contribution. A plural original basis therefore leaves common coverage unsettled without keeping every actual original witness hypothetical.

V008240.text: Two steps need separate reasons. First, a real productive resource has an actual bearer. Second, some such bearer is original as to its whole existential actuality. The first does not alone entail the second: a received organism has genuine intrinsic powers and can initiate a new exercise. The required additional principle concerns the concrete instantiation of the original resource, not merely who performs a local act. The bearer commitment applies to that original resource itself, not only to a downstream effect.

V008241.text: If a bearer’s being actual at all is existentially received, the concrete instantiation of its intrinsic power is not thereby an originally existing resource independent of that receipt. Its efficacy may be real, essential and locally sufficient, while its existential possession remains received. Asfahani printed p. 34 and pp. 80–82 / PDF p. 41 and pp. 87–89 supplies the qualified-bearer rationale; Oneness printed pp. 19 and 34–35 / PDF pp. 26 and 41–42 concerns actual possessed efficacy. Sixth already articulated the received-active-power distinction.

V008242.text: This transport concerns genuine ontological support, not mere modal co-occurrence. It does not infer an efficient-production edge from bearer to attribute. The power need not be a separate object manufactured by its bearer. The point is that the bearer’s received actuality cannot be a required condition of the same intrinsic resource’s instantiation and then be omitted when declaring that instantiation wholly original. Under the accepted exhaustive whole-existence target, that principle has sufficient rational warrant.

V008243.text: If some members of a plural basis possess original whole-existence actuality, one such actual member supplies the witness. If a genuine original holistic bearer supplies derivative members, that whole supplies it without making every member original. A proposal assigning originality only to a relational or noncausal explanation, while every concrete bearer is derivative, changes the adopted realisation commitments; it is not ordinary plurality preserving them. This does not refute every alternative ontology or turn a noncausal ground into a material body.

V008244.text: Fix the actual original bearer so secured. The accepted contingency-as-need principle says that genuine openness to complete nonexistence entails existential need. If this same bearer were contingent, its whole existence would be received, contrary to the established originality in that respect. Actuality excludes impossibility. The conclusion is therefore some actual Necessary Being, with necessity attached to the same witness throughout.

V008245.text: This is a real philosophical entailment under the adopted rationally warranted principles, rather than an unconditional theorem from local causal axioms or generic fact-PSR. By itself it does not prove essential nonreceipt, necessary particular acts or a necessary whole history. The next section earns the first of those further conclusions through an additional constitutive judgement. One individually complete common Creator remains a stronger result; that separate question must not erase the actual Necessary Being conclusion already earned.

V008246.text: Essential independence of that same bearer

V008247.text: Necessary existence and actual nonreceipt are different claims. A reality might be described as necessarily supplied; actual originality does not alone exclude a different existential explanation elsewhere. The stronger source account supplies an additional reason: whole-existence reception or self-sufficiency concerns the constitution of the particular reality itself. I accept that constitutive judgement as sufficiently warranted for defeasible belief. With it, the same actual Necessary Being is essentially independent in its whole existential actuality.

V008248.text: Asfahani printed pp. 25–27 / PDF pp. 32–34 gives positive existential sufficiency through the reality itself, rather than absence of an observed supplier. Printed pp. 30–34 / PDF pp. 37–41 allows real intrinsic qualifications while rejecting an externally assembled, attribute-free substrate. El-Tobgui, printed pp. 266–268 and 299–301 / PDF pp. 290–292 and 323–325, explains the particular reality and its mode of existence together. These passages support the interpretation; the exact inference across alternatives is an analytical reconstruction, not a quotation of a modern modal formula from the source.

V008249.text: The positive rationale concerns what makes the bearer available for any exercise or alteration. A recipient can change suppliers without ceasing to be a recipient. But replacing whole-existence receipt with sufficiency through the particular reality itself changes the source of its existential adequacy. There is no already actual, existentially neutral bearer to which either manner of having actuality is simply added. That explanatory role gives a reason to treat this difference as constitutive, rather than as another contingent manifestation.

V008250.text: The strongest objection asks why the very same individual could not exist through itself here and through another elsewhere. Actual inseparability alone does not answer it. Neither does the word intrinsic: a currently intrinsic configuration might be contingent. Asfahani printed pp. 83–84 / PDF pp. 90–91 itself distinguishes standing qualification from conditioned manifestations. The affirmative therefore needs the further judgement that the source of whole existential adequacy belongs to this reality's constitution. I judge its explanatory rationale sufficient; I do not claim every identity theory has thereby been refuted.

V008251.text: The transport is general and applies in the required direction. If this same bearer were wholly existentially received elsewhere, the constitutive account would make it a received reality wherever it exists, including actually. That contradicts its established actual originality. The result is essential nonreceipt together with the already warranted necessity of that same bearer. Merely asserting that it cannot receive elsewhere would repeat the conclusion without giving this rationale.

V008252.text: This does not make every actual predicate essential or identify all dependence with efficient production. It permits externally related activities and renewed acts, and does not establish numerical uniqueness, complete actual creatorhood or one necessary history. An alleged redundant supplier either contributes genuine existential dependence, which conflicts with autonomy, or falls outside the relevant receipt relation. Sixth already owned the essential-reception distinction and conditional inference. The increment is the favourable appraisal of its constitutive premise applied to the now-earned actual witness.

V008253.text: Asfahani printed pp. 109–111 / PDF pp. 116–118 supplies the separate all-pure-perfections route. Al-Ujayri printed pp. 121–125 and 195–199 / PDF pp. 125–129 and 199–203 gives integrated order and explanatory economy positive roles. The epistemology collection and Asfahani printed pp. 184–186 / PDF pp. 191–193 also allow warranted recognition through convergent signs without one compulsory syllogistic sequence. A description of that route does not establish that this assessor has independently realised it, and withholding one argumentative verdict does not remove another person's adequately grounded recognition.

V008254.text: The longer Arabic discussion gives substantive support to practical perfection. Asfahani printed pp. 411–419 / PDF pp. 511–519 answers the objection that pursuing an end necessarily betrays prior deficiency. A fitting act need not occur before its appropriate occasion; realising one's own loved ends through one's own agency differs from receiving constitutive improvement from an independent benefactor. Informed ability to realise fitting ends is superior to incapacity or practical indifference. Successive realised goods need not postpone fulfilment forever.

V008255.text: Suleiman printed pp. 284–289 / PDF pp. 297–302 connects this with justice and essential wisdom. The positive judgement concerns substantive practical excellence, not approval of whatever a source happens to do. Arabic pp. 403–405 and 408 / PDF pp. 503–505 and 508 answers the necessity-versus-choice objection: wise willing can be necessary and still voluntary through the source's own knowledge, reasons and will. Neither this result nor the practical-perfection appraisal determines a unique complete history.

V008256.text: The veracity argument concerns an additional eligible excellence: faithful informed declaration. A genuine assertion offers a determinate content as the speaker's own account of reality. A knowingly false assertion remains an assertion and can preserve full knowledge. Its defect lies in the source's deliberate counterfeit of its own truth-directed presentation, not necessarily in ignorance, lost expressive capacity or a listener's actual error. Silence leaves a truth unsaid; false assertion exercises the declarative power contrary to that undertaking.

V008257.text: The retained al-Nubuwwat electronic subsection 9 and Akmaliyya loci already connect truthfulness with wisdom and perfection. A newly inspected Minhaj argument supplies more specific support. In the electronic opening and continuation identified in the source register, Ibn Taymiyya distinguishes qualities created in other bearers from qualities inhering in the source itself. He then applies the perfection argument to the source's own speech. These are his replies, not al-Razi's objections. The nonvolitional branch links truth with knowledge; the voluntary branch needs the distinct practical-perfection argument and cannot borrow that identification without explanation.

V008258.text: I now judge the cumulative case sufficient for defeasible acceptance of exceptionless veracity in genuinely source-owned assertions. Faithful informed expression is a positive excellence that does not depend on ignorance, bodily need, borrowed cognition or external sanction. Deliberately counterfeiting it is a defect in that very exercise. The original-perfection comparison gives substantive reason to preserve this integrity as a constraint on fitting purposes, rather than treating an internal declarative deficiency as purchasable by any sufficiently valuable external result. The next section states the continuing objection and why my earlier adverse appraisal changes.

V008259.text: This direct route requires the same bearer's defended essential whole-existence independence, perfect knowledge, substantive practical perfection and eligible pure-perfection standing, together with genuine ownership of the assertion. It does not additionally require numerical uniqueness or exclusive actual creation of the whole field. Minimal necessary existence alone does not supply that attribute package, and attributes cannot be transferred from an unrelated possible being. Unrestricted eligible standing power reinforces the source-specific comparison without proving that every desirable end has a truthful substitute.

V008260.text: The remaining veracity disagreement and the revised judgement

V008261.text: The strongest prior objection had real force. Arabic Asfahani printed pp. 422–423 / PDF pp. 522–523 explains why omnipotence does not make all means dispensable: obtaining one endpoint directly may lose another party's good or a good borne by the process itself. Printed pp. 430–431 / PDF pp. 530–531 extends greater-good and lesser-harm comparison to creation. Suleiman printed pp. 286–287 / PDF pp. 299–300 provides related exposition. Independence does not abolish every evaluatively relevant relation among ends.

V008262.text: The newly recovered Minhaj reply nevertheless blocks a direct transfer from created relative evil to defects of the source's own declaration. Creating another person's ignorance does not make the source ignorant; producing another person's false speech does not make it the source's assertion. A contrary in its own informed declaration has a different locus. The earlier affirmative account already owned this distinction. The new primary argument materially grounds it and shows why general means–end considerations do not themselves defeat the source-specific integrity rationale.

V008263.text: The critical reviewer accepts that correction and continues to withhold sufficient warrant. A knowing liar can retain cognition, expressive power and control; blindness and muteness are therefore imperfect analogies. The reviewer also invokes a finite defender's justified false assertion to save an innocent person. Its content remains false and its truth-directed presentation remains counterfeit, yet the complete action can be justified. Ownership and inherence alone therefore do not settle exceptionless purity. This remains substantive dissent, not a demand for an explicit source sentence or unanimous agreement.

V008264.text: I now accept the affirmative response. Practical perfection concerns fitting exercises as well as faculties, so a contrary exercise need not remove a capacity to be internally deficient. The finite rescue case shows that an agent can choose the better available course while retaining a respect-specific shortcoming imposed by its situation. It does not establish the same shortcoming as compatible with unqualified original perfection. Logical and practical relations survive independence, but no source-specific rationale here makes this bearer's own counterfeit declaration their fitting necessary condition. The positive integrity comparison outweighs that unspecified further-good proposal at the stated defeasible standard.

V008265.text: This is a revision of my earlier withholding on the full argument. The earlier assessment and the continuing critic's refined objection are preserved. The new conclusion is not inferred merely from historical attribution, speech inherence or an opponent's failure to produce an actual lie. Its basis is the cumulative positive account of informed declarative excellence and original practical perfection. No neutral theorem, unanimity, or proof that every conceivable end admits a truthful replacement is claimed.

V008266.text: The Arabic Asfahani truth discussion, printed pp. 444–450 / PDF pp. 544–550, remains more limited: it contains the Mu'tazilite argument reported by al-Razi, al-Razi's criticism and Ibn Taymiyya's reply from p. 448. Its controlled comparison supports truth's noninstrumental worth; the new Minhaj speech argument must not be retroactively put into every voice there.

V008267.text: Defeasibility qualifies our warrant, not the conclusion’s scope: if the stated premises hold, contrary owned assertions are excluded, not merely unlikely. Genuinely asserted contextual content and a false assertion called a test remain within scope. Quotation, fiction, questions, commands and caused sounds are not automatically assertions of their represented content. No blanket permission for nonassertoric misleading follows. Actual occurrence, attribution, content, recipient competence and practical authority still require their own warrant. No revelation or messenger has been newly authenticated, and necessary standing integrity does not fix the whole cosmic history.

V008268.text: Objective fittingness and the scope of authority

V008269.text: Given an actual Creator with substantive essential wisdom, the source account explains objective creaturely fittingness. Real natures, powers, relations, benefits and impairments are originated and ordered through fitting purposes. Cognitive capacities can give access to those goods. Relationality is not subjectivism: what damages a creature can depend on its nature and circumstances without depending on an observer’s preference.

V008270.text: A wider wise purpose need not erase local harm. A condition may genuinely impair a creature while being permitted for another good. Arabic Asfahani printed pp. 419–420 / PDF pp. 519–520 also distinguishes creative willing from love and command. Occurrence alone does not establish approval or permission; noncompliance does not itself defeat a command’s governing purpose. These distinctions make the account informative about actual relations rather than approving every event under an unspecified redescription.

V008271.text: Asfahani printed p. 226 / PDF p. 233 endorses a combined account of value and command. A deed can have value in its own features, a command can disclose it, and commanding can introduce a further wise practical relation. The newly read Arabic p. 429 / PDF p. 529 grounds freedom from rightful reproach in complete knowledge, wisdom, mercy and justice rather than merely domination, will and power. It directly reinforces the positive case for rightful governance beyond superior force.

V008272.text: The account can support determinate local norms when the creature, respect, circumstances and evidence are identified. A warranted correction need not await an exhaustive unique metaethic. Not every local benefit creates a duty for every agent, however. A claim of divine direction does not authenticate its speaker, and permission to believe a proposition does not establish authority to govern another person or implement it.

V008273.text: Al-Ujayri distinguishes goodness without belief in God from goodness existing without God at printed pp. 25–45 / PDF pp. 29–49. His converse inference from objective norms to an absolute personal Maker remains underargued in the inspected passages. Objective correctness and a concrete necessary producer do not become identical because both are called absolute. This limitation leaves the constructive forward account under the wise-Creator grant intact.

V008274.text: Three sufficiency questions consequently have different answers. The source's existence and productive power can remain intrinsically sufficient. The complete explanation of this particular exercise can include its occasion and renewed determination. A complete contrastive explanation of this whole history from necessary intrinsic character alone is a further claim. Treating these as identical either imports the collapse-producing premise or assumes the alternatives still requiring warrant.

V008275.text: The conditional modal consequence is settled. If a necessarily fixed complete occasion has one uniquely best act, essential wisdom requires it, and effective power secures it, that act is necessary. If the whole necessary intrinsic nature uniquely requires one complete history, that history is necessary. Temporal renewal and reasons-responsive agency do not interrupt those entailments.

V008276.text: The source-level question is whether the stronger global premises hold. An actual sequence of locally determined occasions does not itself establish one unique complete sequence. The admitted beginningless succession offers no demonstrated necessary first state from which to derive every later differentiation. Conversely, lack of a first state is not evidence that several histories are metaphysically possible. A global uniqueness argument or a warranted alternative realisation is needed for those respective conclusions.

V008277.text: The result is voluntary, reasons-responsive necessitation with intrinsic possibility and dependence-based necessity distinguished. This is an analytical description, not attribution to a modern school. The texts supply neither a completed libertarian freedom proof nor a proof of whole-history necessity. They also do not reduce perfection to an eternally idle capacity: Suleiman printed p. 240 / PDF p. 253 and pp. 281–286 / PDF pp. 294–299 give perpetual wisdom-based activity positive standing. Necessary generic activity, if granted, still does not identify every particular act.

V008279.text: The completed ordinary-entitlement result is affirmative. A competent recipient may believe an undefeated, warrantedly understood ordinary report, including an unfamiliar person's report, without first independently certifying the speaker or settling which philosophical theory uniquely explains the permission. The separate exact-text conceptual review found no blocking defect at that expressly defeasible ordinary scope.

V008280.text: Burge's mature account supplies a positive rationale through presumed adequate epistemic backing and competent uptake. His Postscript distinguishes the acceptance entitlement from the actual route supporting knowledge and gives human comprehension an empirical warrant. The comparison with Fricker does not establish one uniquely correct universal a priori explanation. These source-based points support the appraisal, rather than converting a bare description of assertion into a deductive proof of entitlement. Relevant loci are Content Preservation pp. 466–470, Postscript pp. 263–275 and 282–284, and Fricker pp. 69–84.

V008281.text: The original assessment's overly demanding stopping criterion has been corrected. Explanatory nonuniqueness is not by itself an undercutter of first-order warrant. If ordinary communication is admitted as a genuine way of learning, a rival account that explains the same permissible belief does not make the belief impermissible. It may change the account of its grounds or the route by which knowledge is acquired.

V008282.text: Consider a competent listener asking a stranger a simple directions question. The answer is apparently asserted, understood, ordinary and not implausible; no relevant evidence of deceit or incompetence is present. Prior acquaintance is not a universal requirement for permissible belief. A restrictive rival needs a positive reason why additional certification is necessary in such a case. Merely saying that the speaker could lie does not supply that reason.

V008283.text: The example does not show that all background social or empirical warrant is absent. Nor does it establish that Fricker herself must deny belief in every such encounter. A role-sensitive account may explain the ordinary answering practice in another way while granting the same permission. The exact review preserved this caution. The disagreement should be located where the accounts actually differ, rather than manufactured by assigning a restrictive everyday verdict to an opponent.

V008284.text: The result does not apply to every intelligible-looking string or unfamiliar technology by default. Comprehension must be warranted; relevant normal competence and reliability matter; concrete signs of misleading context, deficient backing or misunderstanding can defeat acceptance. A hidden defect may prevent knowledge even when the recipient's entitlement persists. Permission to believe is fallible, does not assign confidence one and does not itself authorise consequential action.

V008285.text: Content occurrence and the preservation of warrant

V008286.text: The foundational epistemology sources connect perception, reasoning, testimony and cumulative signs without forcing every route to begin with the same certification. El-Tobgui's thesis, printed pp. 248–288 / PDF pp. 272–312, develops actual cognition and meaningful common predication. His anthology contribution, particularly PDF pp. 77–85 and note 153 at PDF p. 116, treats qualitative transmission and functionally equivalent routes. These accounts can support genuine learning rather than merely growing confidence in uninterpreted marks.

V008287.text: A report's proposition, its contextual content, its actual attribution and its practical authority remain separate. A sentence can express a true proposition without having been uttered by the alleged source. A genuine utterance can be misunderstood. A correctly understood and well-warranted report can still fall short of a permission to act in a particular role. These are differences in what has been established, not arbitrary procedural barriers.

V008288.text: Shared-source dependence also need not destroy knowledge. Faithful transmission can preserve a good epistemic route. Yet ten copies of one report do not automatically provide ten independent evidential roots. Additional access is valuable according to the error it can check: content corruption, mistaken authorship, source incompetence and failure of the original observation are different possibilities. Counting access points without identifying their relation can overstate corroboration.

V008289.text: The retained programme already distinguishes preservation from new independent support, and finite independence certificates from general tawatur warrant. The present source reading offers useful connected illustrations and stronger interpretive context. It does not demonstrate a blanket programme error or supply a new preservation theorem. Rewording an inherited distinction in the vocabulary of a newly read book would not establish novelty.

V008290.text: The ordinary-entitlement result makes the methodological consequence more positive. A competent reader can accept a sufficiently supported methods report without resolving the entire philosophy of testimony. However, entitlement attaches to the report's warranted content. A statement of per-question randomisation does not silently specify every cross-person, cross-time and conditioning relation needed by one exact test. Trusting the report and making an explicit further model assumption can be reasonable while remaining different acts.

V008295.text: The same work distinguishes prevention, removal, mitigation and resistance short of elimination. Later restoration can return a person to a former condition, leave them below it or lead higher through changed understanding. This cautions against reducing every practical good to one binary success label. It does not promise improvement through wrongdoing or prove that every formal binary criterion is inadequate. [4, pp. 9–15, 205–212]

Knowing the better course and effectively resolving to act are separately examined. Uninvited thought is also distinguished from deliberately entertaining it, and ordinary affection from exclusive ultimate allegiance. Earlier severe language must be read with these later qualifications. The long favourable case for passion belongs to an interlocutor before the author’s reply and closing attribution critique. Preserving those voices prevents a selected striking passage from becoming the whole book’s position. [4, pp. 220–224, 353–363, 424–446, 508–573]

Alongside avenues 1–3, these gains chiefly inform avenue 6, warranted collective diagnosis; avenue 7, identity through copying and synchronisation; and avenue 11, occurrence-sensitive language. They separate a source’s contribution, the carrier’s occurrence and the recipient’s warrant rather than treating a collective or copied result as automatically preserving all three. They identify concrete comparison questions and stronger scope controls. They add no fresh Lean result, implemented restoration mechanism or independently validated psychology. Presently orthogonal theology, historical disputes and literary material remain in the separate index on their own terms.
Intentional attestation and the al Walid case
A positive route with independent evidential content

The completed attestation assessment accepts a defeasible recognition route. An event’s discriminating organisation can make best sense as an informed agent’s adoption of a determinate claim for an audience. The evidence concerns why these message-bearing features occur in this setting, rather than merely why the event exists. The basic contextual king-sign route was already owned by Seventh; the present advance is Arabic-source alignment and a more exact discrimination test. [7, pp. 537–543, 675–685, 695–716; 11]

Relevant evidence can include content-sensitive response, independently supported control of the display, correction of misattribution, credible conduct and convergence between evidence vulnerable to different errors. These are not universal checkboxes or synonyms for endorsement. Their actual explanatory comparison must be shown. A generic benefit following a request does not answer every claim made by the requester. Attaching “if I am truthful” to a request cannot force the Creator to adopt its premise.

The retained Nubuwwāt material rejects universal origination, a challenge and non-opposition as automatic discriminators. Its examples distinguish answered requests from endorsement and require attention to the direction of an entire episode. A surprising event can be beneficial, punitive, permissive or testing without constituting a source-owned assertion. Conversely, an imagined test does not automatically defeat concrete evidence of adoption, and calling an actual false assertion a test would not exempt it from retained veracity. [11]

This is positive warrant, not a demand to eliminate every imaginable alternative. It is also conditional upon actual discriminating evidence. Honesty is not immunity from error; particular accuracy is not unrestricted authority. The completed assessment authenticates no historical revelation or token. It does not derive a universal guarantee against misleading nonassertoric appearances from source-owned veracity.
What the selected historical example actually supplies

The conclusion reaches the actual productive field for which the original-resource account and real connectedness are warranted. It is stronger than finding an unrelated necessary being or a root somewhere in one ancestry. It identifies one complete original provider of that field and excludes an independent co-original contributor within it.

The conclusion does not by itself identify every necessary or original reality outside that field with this source. Absolute supremacy supplies a distinct wider route, but its unrestricted comparative scope needs its own warrant. A separate activity-kind appraisal gives positive grounds against a permanently productively idle qualified duplicate: indefinite nonexercise omits an excellence different from this optional token’s absence. That judgement does not exclude a genuinely disconnected active original, and is not itself a consequence of field connectedness. An unproved out-of-field rival is not thereby established as possible, actual or equally credible. These limits should neither erase the field-wide result nor turn it into an unrestricted uniqueness claim.

The same-bearer mapping matters downstream. If the bearer fixed by the earlier attribute arguments is an actual independent original contributor to this same field, the exclusion of a second such contributor identifies it with the common source. If its participation is not established, two existential statements alone do not identify their witnesses. The mapping must be shown or the accepted attribute rationale applied to the suitably qualified common source.
Avenue 1 and original actuality

Avenue 1 gains common-source identification for the relevant received reality and its actual productive support. A correction or cognitive exercise within the warranted field need no longer be left with an unidentified original provider on the ground that the earlier witness might be only one among several originals. This is the actual increment; the minimal necessary bearer, whole-field original completion and essential-independence judgements were already affirmative.

Other incomplete bridges also remain incomplete on their own terms: E_A achievement preservation and RP5, the qualifying cone for a local original participant, actual disjointness of purported contributors, empirical mechanism and calibration for stochastic support, and the separate all-parts or fusion argument in the Koons totality route. Their smaller constructive results are preserved. A successful common-source route does not furnish missing premises to every earlier route, nor establish a generic transition from any noncausal explanation to a concrete efficient creator.
Avenue 2 and source owned veracity

Avenue 2 gains identification of the previously defended truthful source with the common original provider, subject to the same-bearer mapping. It does not first establish essential T0. Seventeenth already accepted exceptionless source-owned veracity under its practical-perfection and integrity premises without requiring strong P2 or unrestricted numerical uniqueness.

T0 concerns the source’s own genuine contextual assertion. D1 still requires an actual communicative occurrence, intentional source ownership or attestation, and determinate content. D2 still requires an adequate recipient route to those facts and an assessment of relevant defeaters. A token’s public assertion of its own source or purpose cannot supply its missing attribution. Silence, quotation, fiction and nonassertoric acts remain distinct.

Common creation therefore gives neither universal truth of created beliefs nor a truthful-message status to every event in the field. Causing or permitting a creature’s false report is different from asserting that report as one’s own. The complete-profile R_G/N bridge also remains unearned by unity, although the independent owned-integrity route need not wait for that bridge.

The absence of an independent original pursuer within the field becomes available at its proper causal scope. It does not show that every good end has a truthful interchangeable means. The accepted direct veracity rationale did not depend on that claim, and the unity result does not substitute it for the source’s own-speech integrity argument.
Avenue 3 and rightful guidance

Avenue 3 gains application of the previously defended wise Creator–creature relation to the connected actual recipients, powers and relations. That account includes substantive fittingness, creaturely fulfilment and impairment, and access to such goods. The gain is more than a name for causal provenance, but it depends on the retained wisdom and normative premises as well as common-source identification.

Efficient production, apprehension, intentional constitution and intrinsic normative character remain different relations. Unity does not identify every normative truth with the producer. Local objective correction and fittingness also need not await an exhaustive theory of ultimate origin. The earlier mental-agency and natural-standard findings keep their own limited achievements.

The prior authority assessment permits a positive command-dependent relational reason and a warranted local binding direction where rightful obligatory address is actually established. Common creation strengthens the identification of the original and continuing giver. Causal ownership alone does not establish unlimited legislative jurisdiction, deliberate legitimate reliance, every requisite precaution or fair coordination. Gratitude supplies no automatic infinite debt, and manufacturing a lack of alternatives creates no authority.

For a bare imperative or an attempted duty-constituting directive, authentic source attribution or an apparent presentation as obligatory is insufficient by itself. Its force must be interpreted, and legitimate obligation-imposing standing must be exercised within scope. A request can be optional. Repeating a directive’s authority claim does not establish those conditions. The wider domain of a general right to specify duties remains a distinct question.

An authenticated source-owned assertion of an obligation is different. Suppose its determinate contextual content is “recipient r is obligated to do a in context c”, and the retained relevant-knowledge and essential owned-veracity premises apply to that same source. Those premises warrant the normative proposition through testimony. A second independent proof of that very obligation or its underlying jurisdiction is unnecessary. The actual obligation is not dispensed with: its obtaining is precisely what the warranted truthful assertion establishes. Such a report need not itself create the duty or identify its ultimate ground.

This transmission of warrant still requires independent authentication of source ownership, contextual content, recipient, time and conditions. The disputed token cannot bootstrap its own attribution. If an authenticated assertion accompanies a constitutive directive and truthfully reports the resulting obligation, the assertion can warrant that obligation without first completing a general theory of legislative authority. Particular implementation, channel identity, feasibility, safety and any further permissions remain distinct from the content warranted.
Source truth recipient warrant and action

The source-side result authenticates no actual revelation, messenger, promise, command or appointed institution. It also does not show that a recipient knows the relevant attribution, proposition, interval, addressee or force. Common ultimate origin neither multiplies independent testimonial roots nor by itself eliminates proximate evidential independence.

No empirical law, lawful intervention, safe root or version, timely disclosure before irreversible action, executable repair channel, or uniform dynamic family follows merely from this metaphysical result. The operational research retains its own evidence and verification. Likewise, intellect and knowledge are inherited here from their separately defended attribute premises, not proved afresh from unity.

The bounded attestation and al-Walid assessments now identify what the available evidence does and does not warrant. They leave actual divine attribution unestablished. Further research may refine the interpretation; source truth, communicative ownership, rightful force and recipient warrant remain distinct tasks. No selected historical token is authenticated merely by the current common-source judgement.
Repository and verification boundary

V009187.title: Localized second-order common-stratum expansion
claims: Both worlds share E U=H_m/m and E M1=(H_(m+1)-1)/(m(m+1)); Markov localizes K+mU, giving a probability-scale remainder only.
The independent review accepts constant 40 and supplies a supplementary safe constant 5 from stronger geometry; later stages use the author constant 40.
A k=1 boundary family with x=1-eta,y=1/2 has log L=(1/m)log eta+O_m(1) while Q stays bounded, ruling out the global cubic-remainder assertion.
limits: Localized does not mean global; no KL, integrated-square, score variance or testing rate follows at this stage.
Common likelihood is unnormalized g1/g0 on K<=n; the alternative-only K=m stratum is not discarded or assigned a finite forward logarithm.
fresh_local_contribution: Explicit deterministic remainder, both-world first-moment localization and nonglobal boundary counterexample.
inherited_not_independent_discovery: Parent supplied leading candidate, geometry and M1 formula; exact likelihood/count predecessors inherited; no duplicate discovery credit.
V009187.assurance: Written proof and scoped separately authored internal review; deterministic controls where supplied; no fresh Lean theorem or replay

V009187.title: Exact fixed-count baseline second and cross moments
claims: Exact formulas for E U_n^2 and E[K_n U_n] follow from two-query geometry and comparable/incomparable orientation accounting.
For a_n=n or n+1, E(K_n-a_n U_n)^2=H_n+O(H_n^2/n); the compensated count is O_P(sqrt(log n)).
For m=n+1 the polynomial Q has E|Q|=O(log n/n^2) and E Q=O(log^2 n/n^3), with E Q_1=-7/72; it is not exactly centered.
Together with the localized expansion, baseline log L=O_P(log n/n^2).
limits: All new second/cross moments are under the product-uniform fixed-count baseline only.
These formulas alone give no E Q^2, likelihood-tail integrability, KL/Hellinger rate or CLT.
fresh_local_contribution: Exact second/cross-moment geometry, cancellation and score L1/mean consequences.
inherited_not_independent_discovery: Parent supplied candidates and proof outline; record facts/first moments are established antecedents.
V009187.assurance: Written proof and scoped separately authored internal review; deterministic controls where supplied; no fresh Lean theorem or replay

V009187.title: Applicable Poisson-hull prior art and fixed-count concentration
claims: Last–Molchanov explicitly covers Pareto minima. The finite stopping-set geometry is matched, including multiplicities and empty configuration.
For both fixed-count worlds, E_j exp(nU/4)<=sqrt((m+1)/p_m), p_m=P(Poi(m)=m)=P(Poi(m)=m-1). Hence P_j(nU>=2 log((m+1)/p_m)+4x)<=exp(-x).
Positive-integer raw moments satisfy E_j(nU)^r=O_r(log^r m); the local remainder-square integral is O(log^6 m/m^6), retaining its domain indicator.
Poisson equalities are not transferred unchanged: conditioning is explicitly charged, and fixed-count E(K-mU)=-1/m is a countercheck to zero centering.
limits: The source theorems are established prior art; the fixed-count concentration is a local deduction with scoped review.
No fixed-count CLT, centered fourth-moment order or information rate follows solely from these raw-moment bounds.
Fill–Naiman frontier widths are not unweighted U; Baldin risk transfer is not arbitrary mixed-moment transfer.
fresh_local_contribution: Exact finite-Pareto hypothesis mapping and self-contained fixed-count concentration using source-guided identities.
inherited_not_independent_discovery: General posterior/variance/exponential identities belong to Last–Molchanov and attributed antecedents. No exhaustive literature or novelty claim; proof specialization is independently checked.
V009187.assurance: Written proof and scoped separately authored internal review; deterministic controls where supplied; no fresh Lean theorem or replay

V009187.title: Unconditioned full-skyline reverse KL: log-four bound
claims: For the fixed hard pair, 0<KL(P0||P1)=O(log^4 n/n^4) and KL(P1||P0)=infinity.
Both-world dyadic tails, raw fourth moments, the localized score, a global reverse-log envelope and a good/bad-window split prove the bound.
For unnormalized common-stratum L, E0 L=1-p_n and KL(P0||P1)=E0[-log L+L-1]+p_n, preserving the positive singular-mass correction.
Actual-action information accounting yields E0 N=Omega_alpha(n^4/log^4 n) for all matching adaptive unchanged-retained-endpoint protocols; a uniform worst-case cap inherits this lower bound.
limits: Log-four review does not certify the later log-squared sibling.
No sharp logarithmic order, finite forward KL, fitted-rate inference or finite physical probe claim.
fresh_local_contribution: Both-world dyadic route, global log envelope, entropy integration and full-skyline adaptive lower bound.
inherited_not_independent_discovery: Root supplied candidate/strategy; exact density, singular mass, coupling and local expansion inherited. No dependency on later Poisson-tail/log-squared work.
V009187.assurance: Written proof and scoped separately authored internal review; deterministic controls where supplied; no fresh Lean theorem or replay

V009187.title: Strengthened unconditioned reverse KL: log-squared bound
claims: For the same fixed pair, 0<KL(P0||P1)=O(log^2 n/n^4), while KL(P1||P0)=infinity.
An exact Poisson skyline posterior gives N|S=K+Poi(mD). The fixed-count/Poisson skyline density ratio is <3 on U<=1/2; the complement is separately superpolynomially controlled.

Poisson compensation identities, justified differentiation and restricted density comparison give E0(K-mU)^4=O(log^2 m). A verified weighted-tilt/conditional-variance identity gives the needed weighted L2 bound and E0 Q^2=O(log^2 m/m^4).

The inherited entropy architecture, including plus p_n singular mass, gives the strengthened reverse KL and E0 N=Omega_alpha(n^4/log^2 n) for started vectors; any finite uniform worst-case cap obeys the same lower order.
The inherited count-test upper bound O_alpha(n^4/log n) leaves one logarithmic factor between bounds.
limits: Only an upper bound on reverse information and lower bound on resource cost, not Theta, a matching logarithmic order, a lower information constant or an optimal test.
The fixed experiment never becomes Poisson; global constant-three density domination is false.
Source-guided specialized identities are proved from skyline densities. The prior-art sharper concentration is acknowledged but not needed in this proof.
fresh_local_contribution: Restricted posterior density transfer, explicit compensated/weighted moment inequalities, integrated score square and log-squared strengthening, with its own final-digest review.
inherited_not_independent_discovery: Parent supplied candidate, derivative relation, transfer/weighted strategy and entropy reuse; Last–Molchanov general identities and local antecedents remain credited. Review is independent verification, not independent theorem discovery.
V009187.assurance: Written proof and scoped separately authored internal review; deterministic controls where supplied; no fresh Lean theorem or replay

V010321.abstract:
<jats:p>Why do human beings move? In this lucid portrayal of human behavior, Fred Dretske provides an original account of the way reasons function in the causal explanation of behavior. Biological science investigates what makes our bodies move in the way they do. Psychology is interested in why persons—agents with reasons—move in the way they do. Dretske attempts to reconcile these different points of view by showing how reasons operate in a world of causes. He reveals in detail how the character of our inner states—what we believe, desire, and intend—determines what we do.</jats:p>
                  <jats:p>Bradford Books imprint</jats:p>
title: Explaining Behavior
subtitle: Reasons in a World of Causes

# T20 — live research continuation (8–9 October 2026)

**Additive reader and evidence projection. T20 remains ACTIVE.**

This is an extension of the **same Orthemology v5 research programme**. It follows the frozen research through Tranche 20 integrated by [PR #31](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/pull/31), alongside [PR #30](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/pull/30) and [PR #32](https://github.com/theislampill/orthemology/pull/32). It does **not** supersede the canonical frozen 7 October result/status/source registries.

The 23 sequential checkpoint ZIPs and the unnumbered warranted-discrimination/Lean supplement were received separately. The original ZIPs, unfiltered execution logs, private source texts and private machine identifiers are **outside Git**; their identities remain in the owner-private handoff. Every public projected file has a source-to-public SHA-256 binding in that handoff. Public projections replace private machine locators with `[OMITTED_PRIVATE_MACHINE_PATH]` where needed. Owner-approved publication markup corrects one CP02 relative link, displays unavailable CP04 historical links as literal locators, and marks one unchanged CP05 formula as inline code to prevent false link parsing. These changes are recorded in the private source-to-public bindings; scientific text and verdicts are not revised. Sixty event/session JSONL files remain private under the repository publication boundary.

## Publication repair boundary

The review repair preserves **23 numbered checkpoints plus S01**: 2,063 source projections and four navigation records, 2,067 public files total. The 24 private original ZIPs still contain 2,978 members; 915 members remain private. Two delivery-only records are withheld. Across the required reports, 207 private Library/file/message linkage occurrences use consistent distinct typed aliases; the other ten occurrences belonged to the withheld records. Aliases preserve identity and equality, including JSON keys, but are not working locators. The original-to-public map remains private. Public source identities and original archive/member hashes are preserved.

Six CP21 references now identify their external owner at [the pinned upstream commit](https://github.com/Nakammura/spinoza-ethica-lean/tree/6d4c0461265e50a3bbedb640fe60d9ad292b50a7). Three JSON path fields become URL fields for the affected records only; one redundant path field is removed while its existing pinned URL remains; two Markdown labels identify upstream registers. This supersedes the earlier CP21 gap-link escaping. The copied component's [original licence](checkpoints/CP21/spinoza-formal-transfer-screen-20261009/sources/LICENSE) is restored byte-for-byte. The [checkpoint index](INDEX.json) records exact public destinations, field transformations, omissions and counts.

Original source/replay hashes in historical records continue to identify original private bytes. Amended projection hashes identify the public copies; these mechanical changes are not new kernel verification, scientific evidence or external peer review. A corrective commit does not remove earlier public history. T20 remains ACTIVE and all stopped or deferred research boundaries remain in force.
